Meridian And Point經絡與穴道

以 Module（經絡）為單位重新編排，不逐張投影片呈現。同一經的功能、循行、腧穴散落在多張投影片者整併同節。英文在左（原講義用字），中文在右，逐段對照；專有名詞「英文 + 中文」並列，穴位以「漢字＋拼音＋編號」標示（如 太溪 Taixi KI-3），因 CTCMPAO 以英文出題。每經在總論之後、逐穴內容之前附「穴位比較表」，末附 Exam focus 考點與速記表。附件 Excel（Function／Dermatome／Muscle／Precaution／Motor Innervation）已整併：非重複的功能重點另標示補充來源，西醫解剖歸入獨立「應用解剖」子區塊，你自己中英夾雜的筆記原樣呈現、不強行翻譯。純圖片的經以影像方式重建穴位卡並保留老師的重點註記。本檔逐 Module 分批建置，目前完成 11/10 ＋ 五輸穴總表。

Module 1 — from Week 1

Channels & Collaterals — General Introduction經絡總論

1.1　Definitions 基本定義（經・絡・經絡）

'Jing' 經 (channel / meridian): Jing means path. The channels are the main pathways running longitudinally and interiorly within the body.
經 Jing（channel／meridian 經脈）：「經」意為路徑。經脈是縱行、深行於體內的主幹通路。
'Luo' 絡 (collateral): Luo means network. The collaterals are the branches — thinner and smaller than channels — that run transversely and superficially over the body.
絡 Luo（collateral 絡脈）：「絡」意為網絡。絡脈是比經脈更細小的分支，橫行、淺行散布於周身。
Jing and Luo are collectively called 'Jingluo' 經絡 or 'Channels and Collaterals'.
經與絡合稱經絡 Jingluo（Channels and Collaterals）。

1.2　Functions of Jing & Luo 經絡的功能

Transport Qi & Blood 運行氣血 throughout the body to integrate the whole: connect organs, sense organs and tissues; connect the Zang-Fu organs to one another; connect the interior to the exterior; link each part of the body to every other part, creating an organic whole.
運行氣血、聯繫整體：聯絡臟腑、官竅與組織；使臟腑相互聯繫；溝通表裏內外；使全身各部連成一個有機整體。
Protect the body 保護機體: the channels prevent the penetration of pathogenic factors (外邪) attacking from outside; they contain and repel pathogens and prevent deeper penetration.
抗禦外邪、保護機體：經絡防止外邪（pathogenic factors）由外侵入；能包容、驅逐病邪，防止其深入。
Respond to dysfunction 反映病候: disease of the channels themselves; disease of the Zang-Fu reflected in the channels; disease transmitting via the channels; the channels visibly show disease.
反映病候：經絡本身之病；臟腑之病反映於經絡；病邪循經傳變；經絡外顯病象。
Transmit Qi to the diseased area 傳導感應、行針施治: treatment and stimulation of Qi can be administered by needling, pressure/massage, heat/moxa, and cupping.
傳導感應、行針施治：可藉針刺、按壓／推拿、艾灸溫熱、拔罐等激發並調整氣的運行。

1.3　Composition & Levels of the Jingluo System 經絡系統的組成與層次

Channels 經脈
  • Twelve regular (primary) channels 十二正經
  • Twelve divergent channels 十二經別
  • Twelve sinew channels / muscle regions 十二經筋
  • Twelve cutaneous regions 十二皮部
  • Eight extraordinary channels 奇經八脈
絡脈 Collaterals
  • Fifteen collaterals 十五絡脈
  • Minute collaterals 孫絡
  • Superficial collaterals 浮絡

Levels — most superficial → deepest:

層次——由淺至深：

  1. Cutaneous regions 皮部
  2. Minute & superficial collaterals 孫絡與浮絡
  3. Muscle regions (Sinew channels) 經筋
  4. Luo-connecting channels 絡脈
  5. Primary channels 正經
  6. Divergent channels 經別
  7. Extraordinary channels 奇經
  8. Deep pathways of the primary & divergent channels 正經與經別的深部循行

1.4　Naming & Body-Surface Distribution 命名法則與體表分布

Each regular channel is named by hand/foot × yin/yang × zang/fu. On the limbs, position maps to the six-channel level:

十二正經以「手／足 × 陰／陽 × 臟／腑」命名。四肢上，體表位置對應六經層次：

Position 位置Yin (medial 內側)Yang (lateral 外側)
Anterior 前Taiyin 太陰 (Lung 肺 / Spleen 脾)Yangming 陽明 (LI 大腸 / Stomach 胃)
Middle 中Jueyin 厥陰 (PC 心包 / Liver 肝)Shaoyang 少陽 (SJ 三焦 / GB 膽)
Posterior 後Shaoyin 少陰 (Heart 心 / Kidney 腎)Taiyang 太陽 (SI 小腸 / Bladder 膀胱)

Yin channels pertain to the six Zang, run on the medial aspect of the limbs and the thoraco-abdominal region. Yang channels pertain to the six Fu, run on the lateral aspect of the limbs, head/face, lumbar region and back.

陰經屬六臟，行於四肢內側及胸腹；陽經屬六腑，行於四肢外側、頭面、腰背。

1.5　The 12 Regular Channels — Flow Directions 十二正經的走向

Group 組Channels 經Direction 走向 (EN)走向 (中)
Three Yin channels of Hand 手三陰Lung 肺 (Taiyin), Pericardium 心包 (Jueyin), Heart 心 (Shaoyin)Begin on the chest → travel the inner (medial) arm → to the hand.起於胸，循臂內側走至手。
Three Yang channels of Hand 手三陽Large Intestine 大腸 (Yangming), San Jiao 三焦 (Shaoyang), Small Intestine 小腸 (Taiyang)Begin on the hand → travel the outer (lateral) arm → to the head.起於手，循臂外側上走至頭。
Three Yang channels of Foot 足三陽Stomach 胃 (Yangming), Gall Bladder 膽 (Shaoyang), Bladder 膀胱 (Taiyang)Begin on the face/eye → travel down the body and outer leg → to the foot.起於頭面（目），下行循腿外側至足。
Three Yin channels of Foot 足三陰Spleen 脾 (Taiyin), Liver 肝 (Jueyin), Kidney 腎 (Shaoyin)Begin on the foot → travel the inner leg → to the chest/flank.起於足，循腿內側上走至胸腹（脅）。

1.6　Channel Pairings 臟腑表裏配對與六經

Zang 臟 (Yin)Fu 腑 (Yang)Six-channel 六經
Lung 肺Large Intestine 大腸Taiyin–Yangming 太陰—陽明
Spleen 脾Stomach 胃Taiyin–Yangming 太陰—陽明
Heart 心Small Intestine 小腸Shaoyin–Taiyang 少陰—太陽
Kidney 腎Urinary Bladder 膀胱Shaoyin–Taiyang 少陰—太陽
Pericardium 心包San Jiao 三焦Jueyin–Shaoyang 厥陰—少陽
Liver 肝Gall Bladder 膽Jueyin–Shaoyang 厥陰—少陽

1.7　TCM Circadian Clock 子午流注（十二時辰經氣流注）

Qi flows through the 12 channels in a 24-hour cycle; each organ peaks in its 2-hour window. The order follows the channel-flow sequence (LU→LI→ST→SP→HT→SI→BL→KI→PC→SJ→GB→LV).

氣血 24 小時循行十二經，各臟腑於其 2 小時時辰當旺；順序即經脈流注次序（肺→大腸→胃→脾→心→小腸→膀胱→腎→心包→三焦→膽→肝）。

Time 時段Organ 臟腑
3–5 amLung 肺
5–7 amLarge Intestine 大腸
7–9 amStomach 胃
9–11 amSpleen 脾
11 am–1 pmHeart 心
1–3 pmSmall Intestine 小腸
3–5 pmUrinary Bladder 膀胱
5–7 pmKidney 腎
7–9 pmPericardium 心包
9–11 pmSan Jiao 三焦
11 pm–1 amGall Bladder 膽
1–3 amLiver 肝

1.8　The 15 Luo-Connecting Channels 十五絡脈

Each Primary channel has one Luo-connecting channel; the Conception (Ren) and Governing (Du) vessels each have one; and the Spleen has a Great Luo — 12 + 2 + 1 = 15.
每條正經各有一絡；任脈（Ren）、督脈（Du）各有一絡；脾另有脾之大絡——12＋2＋1＝15 絡。
Comes out of the main channel at the Luo-connecting point.
從正經之絡穴別出。
Connects with the internally–externally related channel and organ.
聯繫相表裏的經與臟腑。
Strengthens the relationship between the Yin and Yang channels and organs.
加強陰陽經與臟腑之間的聯繫。
More superficial than the Divergent channels, and — unlike Divergent channels — have their own points.
較經別淺表；且與經別不同，絡脈有自己的腧穴（絡穴）。

1.9　The 12 Divergent Channels 十二經別

Circulate deeper than the main channels.
循行較正經更深。
Associated with / take their names from the 12 primary channels.
隸屬並命名於十二正經。
All break off near the lower body and re-join in the upper body.
皆於下肢部別出，於上身（頭項）復合。
Yang divergent: separate from the Yang main channel, enter the Fu organ (often also the Zang), and rejoin the main channel near the neck.
陽經經別：由陽正經別出，入其腑（常兼入臟），於頸項處復合於本經。
Yin divergent: separate from the Yin main channel, connect with the Zang organ, join the paired Yang divergent, then join the Yang main channel at the neck.
陰經經別：由陰正經別出，連其臟，合於相表裏之陽經別，再於頸項合入陽經。
They have departure (別) and meeting (合) points where they enter and exit.
有出入之「離、合」（departure/meeting）部位。

Functions of the Divergent Channels 經別的功能

  • Regulate distribution of Qi, Blood, Yin, Yang and Fluids 調節氣、血、陰、陽、津液的分布
  • Enhance the relationship between exterior and interior 加強表裏聯繫
  • Protect against pathogens going deeper 防止病邪深入
  • Allow Yin–Yang paired channels to interact 使陰陽表裏兩經相互溝通
  • Allow a paired channel to take on excess or support deficiency 使表裏經能瀉實補虛、彼此支援
  • Regulate and nourish Zang-Fu organs 調養臟腑
  • Connect the head with the body and organs 聯繫頭部與軀幹臟腑

Clinical relevance 臨床意義

  • Treat conditions along their pathways, including areas the primary channel does not reach 治循行所過之病，含正經未及之處
  • Treat their associated paired internal organs 治其所屬表裏臟腑之病
  • Treat conditions of their paired primary channel 治相表裏正經之病
  • Treat conditions of the sinew channel 治經筋之病

1.10　The 12 Sinew Channels 十二經筋

Circulate on the periphery of the body; do not penetrate to the Zang-Fu.
循行於體表；不入臟腑。
Associated with / take names from the 12 primary channels.
隸屬並命名於十二正經。
All originate at the extremities and ascend to the head and trunk.
皆起於四肢末端，上行至頭身。
Broadly follow the course of their primary channels but are wider.
大致沿本經循行，但範圍更廣。
More superficial; follow lines of major muscles, tendons, ligaments and connective tissue.
較淺表，循主要肌肉、肌腱、韌帶與結締組織分布。

Clinical relevance 臨床意義

  • Reflect disturbances of the primary channels 反映正經之病
  • Can be injured themselves — via trauma or exterior pathogens 可自身受損（外傷或外邪）
  • Accessed with shallow insertions (esp. Ahshi points 阿是穴), cupping, TuiNa massage, plum-blossom needling, dermal needling, guasha 以淺刺（尤取阿是穴）、拔罐、推拿、梅花針、皮膚針、刮痧等治之

1.11　The 12 Cutaneous Regions 十二皮部

Not channels, but skin regions over broad networks of superficial channels, linked to them.
並非經脈，而是覆蓋於淺表經絡網之上的皮膚分區，與其相連。
Provide the theoretical basis for External Pathogenic Invasion (EPI) passing through the skin into deeper layers of the jingluo system.
為外邪由皮膚內傳（EPI）深入經絡系統提供理論基礎。
Can manifest disorders of the deep-lying channels (odd skin sensations, lesions, discolouration).
可顯現深部經脈之病（異常皮膚感覺、皮損、色澤改變）。
Explain how cutaneous-level treatments can have a deep therapeutic effect.
說明何以體表治療能產生深部療效。

1.12　Collaterals in Detail 絡脈詳解（含浮絡・孫絡）

Composition: 12 collaterals branch off the 12 regular channels; 2 branch off Ren & Du; plus the Great collateral of the Spleen.
組成：十二絡自十二正經別出；任、督各一絡；另加脾之大絡。
Distribution: more superficial than the primary channel; branches off at the Luo point and connects to the internally–externally paired channel, then continues its own course over the four limbs.
分布：較正經淺表；於絡穴別出，連相表裏之經，再循自身路徑走布四肢。
Function: the 12 collaterals strengthen the association between externally–internally related channels and Zang-Fu.
功能：十二絡加強表裏經與臟腑間的聯繫。
Superficial & Minute collaterals: superficial collaterals distribute over superficial body parts; minute collaterals are the smallest branches — both are innumerable, spread all over the body to transport Qi and Blood to the surface.
浮絡與孫絡：浮絡分布於體表；孫絡為最細小之分支——二者不可勝數，遍布全身，將氣血輸布至體表。

1.13　Clinical Applications of Channel Theory 經絡學說的臨床應用

1. Explain pathological changes 闡釋病理 — channels are the route by which pathogens invade and by which disease interacts among organs/tissues: interior–exterior Zang-Fu (e.g. HT & SI 心與小腸); organ–organ (e.g. LV & ST 肝與胃；HT & KD 心與腎); Zang & sense organ (e.g. LV & eyes 肝開竅於目；GB & ears 膽與耳); Zang-Fu & tissue (e.g. ST & gums 胃與齒齦；HT & tongue 心與舌). They reflect channel pathology (e.g. Liver disease → hypochondriac pain and distension).
1. 闡釋病理變化——經絡是外邪侵入與臟腑組織間病理相互作用的通路：表裏臟腑（如心與小腸）；臟臟／臟腑（如肝與胃、心與腎）；臟與官竅（如肝開竅於目、膽與耳）；臟腑與組織（如胃與齒齦、心與舌）。並反映經脈病候（如肝病→脅肋脹痛）。
2. Guide diagnosis 指導診斷 — symptoms reflect dysfunction of channels and their organs: hypochondriac & lower-abdominal pain → Liver 肝; shoulder pain → Small Intestine 小腸; neck/back problems → Bladder channel of foot Taiyang 足太陽膀胱經. Reactive changes along channels/points: tenderness, tubercles, cord-like nodules, changes in appearance, temperature, or skin electrical resistance.
2. 指導臨床診斷——症候反映經脈與所屬臟腑失調：脅肋與少腹痛→肝；肩痛→小腸；項背痛→足太陽膀胱經。並可見循經或穴位的反應：壓痛、結節、條索狀物、外觀／溫度／皮膚電阻改變。
3. Guide treatment 指導治療 — acupuncture transports and stimulates channel Qi, restores Zang-Fu function and Qi-Blood/Yin-Yang balance. Point selection: choose points along the affected channel (differentiation-based). E.g. Heat: Liver → 行間 Xingjian LV-2; Stomach → 內庭 Neiting ST-44. Distal points: shoulder pain → 後溪 Houxi SI-3; back pain → 委中 Weizhong BL-40; gastric disorder → 足三里 Zusanli ST-36.
3. 指導針灸治療——針灸能運行、激發經氣，恢復臟腑功能與氣血、陰陽平衡。取穴：循病經取穴（辨證論治）。如熱證：肝取行間 Xingjian LV-2、胃取內庭 Neiting ST-44。循經遠取：肩痛取後溪 Houxi SI-3、腰背痛取委中 Weizhong BL-40、胃病取足三里 Zusanli ST-36。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Module 1 高頻考點 · 經絡總論

  • 六經體表分布（必考）：四肢內側前中後＝太陰 Taiyin・厥陰 Jueyin・少陰 Shaoyin；外側前中後＝陽明 Yangming・少陽 Shaoyang・太陽 Taiyang。記口訣「內前太陰、內中厥陰、內後少陰」。
  • 十二經流注順序（必背）：肺→大腸→胃→脾→心→小腸→膀胱→腎→心包→三焦→膽→肝，回到肺。子午流注時辰題直接考此序（肺 3–5am 起）。
  • 四肢走向規律：手三陰胸→手、手三陽手→頭、足三陽頭→足、足三陰足→胸腹。
  • 經別 vs 絡脈易混：經別更深、無自己的穴；絡脈較淺、有絡穴。經別「離合出入」、下出上合。
  • 十五絡的組成：12 正經＋任＋督＋脾之大絡＝15（別漏脾大絡）。
  • 皮部的臨床意義：EPI 外邪由皮內傳之理論基礎；解釋淺表治療產生深部療效。
  • 循經取穴例（配對題）：肩痛後溪 SI-3、腰背痛委中 BL-40、胃病足三里 ST-36、肝熱行間 LV-2、胃熱內庭 ST-44。

小考 QUIZM1 · 經絡總論　自我測驗（7 題）

點選答案即顯示正誤與解析；可用左上語言鈕切換中／英。題目取自你的 CTCMPAO 題庫（針灸學＋中醫基礎經絡相關題）。
Q1 · 題源 acup-58　正解 A
SI channel belongs to:

  • BShao Yang少陽
  • CYang Ming陽明
  • DJue Yin厥陰
A — The Small Intestine (SI) channel belongs to the Tai Yang level (Hand Tai Yang). Its paired channel is the Bladder (Foot Tai Yang). Together they form the Tai Yang exterior level.A——小腸經屬於太陽（手太陽）。其配對經絡是膀胱經（足太陽）。兩者共同構成太陽表層。
Q2 · 題源 acup-59　正解 C
Foot Yang meridians include:
足陽經包括：
  • AST, SP, LR胃、脾、肝
  • BLU, LI, ST肺、大腸、胃

  • DHT, SI, UB心、小腸、膀胱

Q3 · 題源 foun-7　正解 B
Which organs are paired through the Shao Yin channel?
哪兩個臟腑通過少陰經配對？
  • AKidney/Bladder腎／膀胱
  • BHeart/Kidney心／腎
  • CHeart/Small Intestine心／小腸
  • DLiver/Heart肝／心
B — The Shao Yin channel pairs the Heart and Kidney — the 'water-fire axis' in TCM. Heart/Small Intestine is a Tai Yang pair. Kidney/Bladder is the Tai Yang/Shao Yin interior-exterior pair.B——少陰經配對心與腎——中醫中的「水火軸」。心/小腸是太陽配對。腎/膀胱是太陽/少陰表裡配對。

哪兩個臟腑通過厥陰經配對？

  • CPericardium/San Jiao心包／三焦
  • DLiver/Gallbladder肝／膽
B — The Jue Yin channel pairs the Liver and Pericardium. Pericardium/San Jiao is Jue Yin/Shao Yang exterior-interior pair. Liver/Gallbladder is the Jue Yin/Shao Yang pair.B——厥陰經配對肝與心包。心包/三焦是厥陰/少陽表裡配對。肝/膽也是厥陰/少陽配對。

Five Element controlling cycle: Liver controls →
五行制約關係：肝制約→
  • AFire火

Q7 · 題源 foun-42　正解 D
Five Element relationship describing cough triggered by emotional stress:
描述情緒壓力引發咳嗽的五行關係：

  • BControlling相克
  • CInvading相乘

Module 2 — from Week 2

Acupuncture Points — Categories, Special Points & Location腧穴總論

2.1　Acupoints — Definition & Classification 腧穴的定義與分類

Acupoints (腧穴) are the specific sites through which the Qi of the Zang-Fu organs and channels is transported to the body surface; they are pathways for the circulation of Qi and Blood, and loci of the response to disease. Needling them regulates the body's functional activity and strengthens resistance to prevent and treat disease.
腧穴 Acupoints 是臟腑經絡之氣輸注於體表的特定部位；為氣血運行的通路，也是疾病反應點。針刺腧穴可調節機體功能、扶正祛邪、防病治病。
Regular points 十四經穴: points of the 12 primary channels plus the Du Mai (督) and Ren Mai (任) — these two extra vessels have their own points.
十四經穴 Regular points：十二正經加督脈、任脈之穴（此二奇經有自己的腧穴）。
Extraordinary points 經外奇穴: points that do not belong to the 14 channels. (The other extra vessels — Chong 衝, Dai 帶, Yangwei 陽維, Yinwei 陰維, Yangqiao 陽蹺, Yinqiao 陰蹺 — have no points of their own.)
經外奇穴 Extraordinary points：不歸於十四經之穴。（其餘奇經——衝、帶、陽維、陰維、陽蹺、陰蹺——無自己的腧穴。）
Ahshi points 阿是穴: points of local tenderness that do not necessarily belong to any channel.
阿是穴 Ahshi points：局部壓痛點，不一定歸於任何經。

2.2　Five Shu Points 五輸穴（60 穴）

The Five Shu (五輸穴, 'Transporting') points — 60 points total — are five specific points on each of the 12 regular channels, located below the elbow/knee. As Qi flows from fingers/toes (Jing-Well) toward elbow/knee (He-Sea), the channel gets bigger and more Qi flows. Clinically very important; associated with the Five Elements.
五輸穴（Five Shu，「輸注」之意）——共 60 穴——為十二正經各自位於肘、膝以下的五個特定穴。氣由指／趾端（井）流向肘／膝（合），經脈漸大、氣漸盛。臨床極重要，並與五行相配。
Jing-Well 井 (tips of fingers/toes): Qi emanates to the surface, can change direction/polarity here. KI-1 湧泉 is the only Jing-Well NOT at a toe (it's on the sole).
井穴 Jing-Well（指／趾端）：氣由此外發，可在此改變方向／極性。湧泉 KI-1 是唯一不在趾端的井穴（在足底）。
Ying-Spring 滎: Qi glides. Shu-Stream 輸: Qi pours. Jing-River 經: Qi flows. He-Sea 合 (elbow/knee): Qi plunges deeply inwards.
滎穴 Ying-Spring：氣溜；輸穴 Shu-Stream：氣注；經穴 Jing-River：氣行；合穴 He-Sea（肘／膝）：氣入（深匯於內）。

Five Elements & mother-son tonify/reduce 五行與母子補瀉

Five Shu points tonify or reduce a channel/organ by the Five Elements. Per the Classic of Difficulties: “In deficiency reinforce the mother; in excess reduce the child.” Each point is the child of the one before it and the mother of the one after.
五輸穴依五行補瀉經／臟腑。《難經》：「虛則補其母，實則瀉其子。」每穴為前者之子、後者之母。
Yin channels start from Wood (Jing-Well=Wood→Fire→Earth→Metal→Water). Yang channels start from Metal (Jing-Well=Metal→Water→Wood→Fire→Earth).
陰經從木起（井木→滎火→輸土→經金→合水）；陽經從金起（井金→滎水→輸木→經火→合土）。
E.g. To tonify the Heart (Fire), needle the Heart-channel mother (Wood) point = HT-9 少衝. To reduce the Heart, needle the child (Earth) point = HT-7 神門.
例：補心（火）取心經母穴（木）＝少衝 HT-9；瀉心取子穴（土）＝神門 HT-7。

2.3　Lower He-Sea Points 下合穴（6 穴）

The six Lower He-Sea points pertain to the six Fu organs; all are on the Yang channels of the leg. They let the three foot-Yang channels communicate with the three hand-Yang channels, and treat disorders of the six Fu (very effective for constipation/diarrhea). LI & SI pertain to the Stomach, so their Lower He-Sea points (ST-37, ST-39) sit on the Stomach channel; SJ connects with the Bladder via the water passages, so its Lower He-Sea (BL-39) is on the Bladder channel.
六下合穴屬六腑，皆在下肢陽經；使足三陽與手三陽相通，主治六腑病（治便秘／腹瀉甚效）。大腸、小腸隸屬於胃，故其下合穴（上巨虛 ST-37、下巨虛 ST-39）在胃經；三焦經水道通於膀胱，故其下合穴（委陽 BL-39）在膀胱經。

2.4　Xi-Cleft (Accumulation) Points 郄穴（16 穴）

Xi-Cleft (郄穴, 'cleft/opening') — 16 points: one on each of the 12 regular channels + 4 extra vessels (Yin/Yang Qiao, Yin/Yang Wei). On the limbs, typically between elbow&wrist or knee&ankle (exception: ST-34 is above the knee). Where Qi & Blood gather and plunge deeper. Indications: acute conditions of channel/organ, pain & Blood. Yin-channel Xi points also treat bleeding disorders (e.g. very effective for lung bleeding).
郄穴（「郄」即孔隙）——16 穴：十二正經各一＋四奇經（陰／陽蹺、陰／陽維）。多位於肘腕或膝踝之間（例外：梁丘 ST-34 在膝上）。為氣血深聚之處。主治：經／臟之急症、痛證、血證。陰經郄穴兼治出血病（如治肺出血甚效）。

2.5　Yuan-Source (Primary) Points 原穴（12 穴）

Yuan-Source (原穴, 'origin') — 12 points, where the Yuan (source) Qi is retained/accessed; near wrists/ankles. On Yin channels they overlap the Shu-Stream point (always the 3rd point). On Yang channels they sit between Shu-Stream and Jing-River (usually the 4th point; GB is the 5th). Yin-channel Yuan points treat their Zang (primary choice); Yang-channel Yuan points dispel excess pathogens and treat channel disorders. Used for diagnosis, and paired with Luo points (Host & Guest 主客配穴).
原穴（「原」即本源）——12 穴，元氣所留、所出之處；近腕踝。陰經原穴與輸穴同一（皆第 3 穴）；陽經原穴位於輸、經之間（多為第 4 穴，膽經為第 5）。陰經原穴主治其臟（首選）；陽經原穴祛邪瀉實、治本經病。可診斷，並與絡穴相配（主客配穴 Host & Guest）。
Unofficial Yuan points of the trunk (Spiritual Pivot Ch.1): CV-15 鳩尾 = Yuan of the chest; CV-6 氣海 = Yuan of the abdomen.
軀幹之「非正式」原穴（《靈樞》一）：鳩尾 CV-15＝胸之原；氣海 CV-6＝腹之原。

2.6　Luo-Connecting Points 絡穴（15 穴）

Luo-Connecting (絡穴) — 15 points: 12 regular channels + Ren + Du + Great Luo of Spleen. The Luo point is where the luo-connecting channel diverges from the primary channel. Treats disorders of the internally-externally related channel/organ, disorders reached by the luo channel, and psycho-emotional disorders. Paired with Yuan points as Host & Guest 主客配穴: e.g. LU affected → Yuan of LU (太淵 LU-9) + Luo of LI (偏歷 LI-6).

2.7　Back-Shu Points 背俞穴（12 穴）

Back-Shu (背俞穴, 'to transport') — 12 points on the Bladder channel, 1.5 cun lateral to the midline, near their organs. Qi is transported directly to the Zang-Fu (not via the channels). Treat internal-organ disorders (excess/deficiency, acute/chronic) — most used for deficiency & chronic, and for fatigue. Also treat the sense organ of the related Zang. Do not treat channel problems (except the BL channel's own).
背俞穴（「俞」即輸）——12 穴，位於膀胱經、後正中線旁開 1.5 寸，近所屬臟腑。氣直接輸注臟腑（非經由經脈）。治內臟病（虛實、急慢）——多用於虛證與慢性病及疲勞。並治相關臟之官竅。除膀胱經本身外，不治經脈病。

2.8　Front-Mu Points & Back-Shu vs Front-Mu 募穴（12 穴）與背俞・募對比

Front-Mu (募穴, 'to gather/collect') — 12 points where Zang-Fu Qi gathers on the anterior body (chest/abdomen), near their organs (only GB-25, Kidney's Mu, is on the back — at the free end of the 12th rib). Only 3 lie on their own related channel (LU-1, GB-24, LR-14); of the rest, 6 lie on the Ren (Conception) vessel. Tonify organs, expel pathogens (esp. Heat), for acute or chronic disease. Combine or alternate with Back-Shu. Do not treat their Zang-Fu's channel problems (except LU-1, GB-24, LR-14).
募穴（「募」即匯聚）——12 穴，臟腑之氣匯聚於胸腹前面，近所屬臟腑（僅腎之募京門 GB-25在背側，第 12 肋游離端）。僅3穴在本經（中府 LU-1、日月 GB-24、期門 LR-14）；其餘中6 穴在任脈。可補臟腑、祛邪（尤清熱），治急慢病。可與背俞相配或交替。除 LU-1、GB-24、LR-14 外，不治所屬臟腑之經病。

2.10　Confluent Points (Eight Extraordinary) 八脈交會穴

Confluent Points (八脈交會穴) — 8 points where primary channels communicate with the 8 extraordinary vessels; they activate the vessel and allow deeper treatment. Each vessel has an opening point and a coupled/paired point, needled in that order (changing the order treats a different channel). Needling depends on sex: women — opening point on the RIGHT, coupled on LEFT; men — opening on LEFT, coupled on RIGHT. The 4 classic pairs: LU-7 + KI-6 (Ren+Yinqiao, lung/throat/chest), SI-3 + BL-62 (Du+Yangqiao, spine/neck), SP-4 + PC-6 (Chong+Yinwei, heart/chest/stomach), GB-41 + TE-5 (Dai+Yangwei, outer canthus/ear/cheek).
八脈交會穴——8 穴，為正經與八奇經相通之處；能激發奇經、深層治療。每脈有開穴（opening）與配穴（coupled），須依序下針（改序則治他經）。針法依性別：女——開穴在右、配穴在左；男——開穴在左、配穴在右。四組經典配對：列缺 LU-7＋照海 KI-6（任＋陰蹺，肺／咽喉／胸）、後溪 SI-3＋申脈 BL-62（督＋陽蹺，脊項）、公孫 SP-4＋內關 PC-6（衝＋陰維，心／胸／胃）、足臨泣 GB-41＋外關 TE-5（帶＋陽維，目外眥／耳／頰）。

2.11　Command Points 四總穴／六總穴

Command Points (四總穴 → 六總穴) treat a whole body area for any ailment there. Classic mnemonic 口訣: 肚腹三里留，腰背委中求，頭項尋列缺，面口合谷收；心胸內關應，急救水溝謀。 Originally 4 points (pre-Ming); later PC-6 (chest/breasts/lateral costal) and GV-26 (resuscitation) were added. Also usable for facial problems.
四總穴（後增為六總穴）治該部位一切病。口訣：肚腹三里留，腰背委中求，頭項尋列缺，面口合谷收；心胸內關應，急救水溝謀。原為 4 穴（明以前），後加內關 PC-6（胸乳脅）、水溝 GV-26（急救）。亦可用於面部問題。

2.12　Crossing Points 交會穴

Crossing Points (交會穴, >90): intersection of 2+ channels; mostly on head, face, trunk. Key points to treat channel disorders of their region. Famous ones: SP-6 三陰交 (SP+LR+KI), GV-14 大椎 (all Yang channels), GV-20 百會 (all Yang), CV-4 關元 (Ren+SP+LR+KI).
交會穴（>90 穴）：兩經以上交會處；多在頭面軀幹。為治所在部位經病之要穴。著名者：三陰交 SP-6（脾＋肝＋腎）、大椎 GV-14（諸陽）、百會 GV-20（諸陽）、關元 CV-4（任＋脾＋肝＋腎）。

2.13　Therapeutic Properties of Points 腧穴的治療特性

1. Remote 遠治: points below elbow/knee treat remote Zang-Fu & tissues along their channel; some have systemic effects.
1. 遠治作用：肘膝以下之穴治循經遠處臟腑組織；部分有全身作用。
2. Local & adjacent 近治: all points treat local and adjacent areas.
2. 近治作用：所有穴皆治局部及鄰近部位。
3. Biphasic regulation 雙向調節: e.g. PC-6 內關 corrects both tachycardia & bradycardia; LI-4 合谷 both induces & stops sweating.
3. 雙向調節：如內關 PC-6 心動過速／過緩皆調；合谷 LI-4 能發汗亦能止汗。
4. Special/empirical 特殊（經驗穴）: GV-14 大椎 antipyretic; BL-67 至陰 corrects fetal malposition.
4. 特殊作用（經驗穴）：大椎 GV-14 退熱；至陰 BL-67 矯正胎位。

2.14　Methods of Locating Points 取穴法（骨度分寸）

All measurements use the cun (寸) — a relative unit based on the patient's own body, not the practitioner's. Proportional (bone) measurement is the most accurate and is applicable to adults/children, thin/obese alike. For exams, points must be located by proportional measurement. Landmarks: fixed (sense organs, hair, nails, nipples, umbilicus, bone prominences/depressions) & moving (creases).
一切度量用寸（cun）——為以患者本人身體為準的相對單位，非術者。骨度分寸法最準，成人／小兒、瘦／胖皆適用。考試須以骨度分寸定位。標誌：固定標誌（五官、髮、甲、乳頭、臍、骨之突陷）與活動標誌（皮褶）。

Eight extraordinary vessels 八奇經命名

CTCMPAO English 英文Chinese 中文
Governor Vessel (GV)Dumai 督脈
Conception Vessel (CV)Renmai 任脈
Flush Vessel (FV)Chongmai 衝脈
Belt Vessel (BV)Daimai 帶脈
Yin Heel Vessel (Yin HV)Yinqiaomai 陰蹺脈
Yang Heel Vessel (Yang HV)Yangqiaomai 陽蹺脈
Yin Link Vessel (Yin LV)Yinweimai 陰維脈

EXAM FOCUS 考點

Module 2 高頻考點 · 腧穴總論

  • 五輸穴五行起點（必考）：陰經井穴屬木（木→火→土→金→水）；陽經井穴屬金（金→水→木→火→土）。母子補瀉：虛補其母、實瀉其子。
  • 原穴 vs 輸穴：陰經「原＝輸」同一穴（皆第 3 穴，如太溪 KI-3）；陽經原穴在輸、經之間（多第 4 穴，膽經第 5）。
  • 下合穴（配對題）：大腸上巨虛 ST-37、小腸下巨虛 ST-39、三焦委陽 BL-39——三者不在本經！胃 ST-36、膽 GB-34、膀胱 BL-40。
  • 八會穴（必背）：臟章門 LR-13、腑中脘 CV-12、氣膻中 CV-17、血膈俞 BL-17、筋陽陵泉 GB-34、脈太淵 LU-9、骨大杼 BL-11、髓懸鐘 GB-39。
  • 八脈交會四組配對（必背）：LU-7＋KI-6（任＋陰蹺）、SI-3＋BL-62（督＋陽蹺）、SP-4＋PC-6（衝＋陰維）、GB-41＋TE-5（帶＋陽維）。開穴先於配穴，順序不可換。
  • 募穴落點：僅 3 穴在本經（LU-1、GB-24、LR-14）；腎募京門 GB-25 在背側是陷阱。六募在任脈。
  • 背俞 vs 募：背俞治陰病／寒／慢性、募治陽病／熱／急性（通常，不完全是）。背俞皆在膀胱經旁開 1.5 寸。
  • 郄穴例外：梁丘 ST-34 在膝上（其餘多在肘腕、膝踝間）。陰經郄穴治血證／出血。
  • Jing-Well 特例：湧泉 KI-1 是唯一不在趾端的井穴。至陰 BL-67（井）矯正胎位。
  • CTCMPAO 代碼陷阱：三焦＝TE（非 SJ／TH）；八奇經用 FV/BV/HV/LV（Flush/Belt/Heel/Link Vessel）。
  • 骨度分寸常考數字：兩乳頭8 寸、臍至恥骨聯合5 寸、肘橫紋至腕橫紋12 寸、膕橫紋至外踝16 寸、前後髮際12 寸。考試一律用骨度分寸。
  • 命令穴口訣：肚腹三里、腰背委中、頭項列缺、面口合谷；心胸內關、急救水溝。

小考 QUIZM2 · 腧穴總論　自我測驗（49 題）

點選答案即顯示正誤與解析；可用左上語言鈕切換中／英。題目取自你的 CTCMPAO 題庫（針灸學＋中醫基礎經絡相關題）。
Q1 · 題源 acup-2　正解 D
Which waveform in electro-acupuncture is easier for human body to generate adaption?
電針中哪種波形更容易使人體產生適應？
  • ASparse-dense wave疏密波
  • BIntermittent wave斷續波
  • CBoth A and BA和B均是
  • DNone of above以上皆非
D — Neither sparse-dense nor intermittent waves are harder to adapt to — in fact, BOTH are actually less likely to cause adaptation than continuous waves. Neither one alone is 'harder'; both are designed to reduce habituation.D——疏密波和斷續波都不容易使人體產生適應，實際上兩者都比連續波更不容易引起適應。兩者都旨在減少習慣化。
Q2 · 題源 acup-3　正解 C
What are the needling depth and directions on Back-Shu points BL13 to BL21?
膀胱經背俞穴BL13至BL21的針刺深度和方向是？
  • AObliquely 0.5 – 0.8 cun斜刺0.5-0.8寸
  • BPerpendicularly 0.3 – 0.5 cun直刺0.3-0.5寸
  • CObliquely 0.5 – 1 cun斜刺0.5-1寸
  • DPerpendicularly 0.5 – 0.8 cun直刺0.5-0.8寸
C — Back-shu points BL13-BL21 are needled obliquely at 0.5-1 cun, directed toward the spine. Perpendicular needling risks pneumothorax in the thoracic region.C——膀胱背俞穴BL13-BL21應斜刺0.5-1寸，方向朝向脊柱。在胸部直刺有氣胸風險。
Q3 · 題源 acup-5　正解 D
Which belongs to both the Luo-Connecting and the Eight Confluent Points?
哪個穴位同時屬於絡穴和八脈交會穴？
  • AKI6 (Zhaohai)腎6（照海）
  • BBL62 (Shenmai)膀胱62（申脈）
  • CSI3 (Houxi)小腸3（後溪）
  • DLU7 (Lieque)肺7（列缺）
D — LU7 (Lieque) is the Luo-Connecting point of the Lung channel AND the confluent point of the Ren Mai. No other point holds this dual distinction among the options given.D——列缺（LU7）既是肺經的絡穴，又是任脈的交會穴。在所給選項中，無其他穴位具有此雙重特性。
Q4 · 題源 acup-7　正解 C
Which alcohol percentage is used for fire cupping?
火罐使用的酒精濃度是多少？
  • A50%50%
  • B70%70%
  • C95%95%
  • D150%150%（不存在）
C — 95% alcohol is used for fire cupping to create a quick, hot flame. 70% alcohol is used for skin disinfection before needling (standard antiseptic concentration).C——95%酒精用於火罐，以產生快速的熱焰。70%酒精用於針刺前皮膚消毒（標準防腐濃度）。
Q5 · 題源 acup-8　正解 C
Which is a Commanding or Si Zong point for head and nape?
哪個穴是頭頸部的四總穴之一？
  • ASJ5 (Waiguan)三焦5（外關）
  • BBL40 (Weizhong)膀胱40（委中）
  • CLU7 (Lieque)肺7（列缺）
  • DPC6 (Neiguan)心包6（內關）
C — LU7 (Lieque) is the commanding/Si Zong point for the head and nape. The four Si Zong points are: LU7 (head/neck), ST36 (abdomen), BL40 (back), and PC6 (heart/chest).C——列缺（LU7）是頭頸部的四總穴之一。四個四總穴是：列缺（頭/頸）、足三里（腹）、委中（背）、內關（心/胸）。
Q6 · 題源 acup-10　正解 A
What is scalp acupuncture mainly used for?
頭皮針主要用於治療什麼？
  • ACerebral disorders腦部疾患
  • BInfection diseases感染性疾病
  • CImmune system diseases免疫系統疾病
  • DGynecological diseases婦科疾病
A — Scalp acupuncture was developed specifically for cerebral (brain) disorders including stroke rehabilitation, paralysis, and other neurological conditions. It maps brain function areas onto the scalp.A——頭皮針專門為腦部疾患而開發，包括中風康復、癱瘓和其他神經系統疾病。它將大腦功能區域映射到頭皮上。
Q7 · 題源 acup-13　正解 B
In ear acupuncture, points related to the digestive tract are distributed around:
在耳針中，消化道相關穴位分佈在：
  • AThe ear lobe耳垂
  • BThe cavum concha耳甲腔
  • CThe antihelix對耳輪
  • DThe helix crus耳輪腳
B — In auricular acupuncture, digestive tract organs are represented in the cavum concha (the hollow area below the antihelix crus). The ear lobe contains face points.B——在耳針中，消化道器官在耳甲腔（耳輪腳下方的凹陷區域）有對應穴位。耳垂含有面部穴位。
Q8 · 題源 acup-16　正解 D
Choose the correct back shu points for the following organs: Lung, Liver, Spleen and Kidney
選擇以下臟腑的正確背俞穴：肺、肝、脾、腎
  • AUB-15, UB-17, UB-21, UB-23膀胱15、17、21、23
  • BUB-13, UB-18, UB-23, UB-25膀胱13、18、23、25
  • CUB-13, UB-17, UB-20, UB-13膀胱13、17、20、13
  • DUB-13, UB-18, UB-20, UB-23膀胱13（肺俞）、18（肝俞）、20（脾俞）、23（腎俞）
D — Lung = UB-13 (Feishu), Liver = UB-18 (Ganshu), Spleen = UB-20 (Pishu), Kidney = UB-23 (Shenshu). These are essential back-shu point locations to memorize.D——肺俞=BL13，肝俞=BL18，脾俞=BL20，腎俞=BL23。這些是必須記憶的重要背俞穴位置。
Q9 · 題源 acup-18　正解 B
What do the Eight Influential Points influence?
八會穴各自影響什麼？
  • AZang organs, Fu organs, meridians, vessels, Qi, blood, Yin, Yang臟、腑、經脈、血脈、氣、血、陰、陽
  • BZang organs, Fu organs, Qi, blood, tendons, vessels, bones, marrow臟、腑、氣、血、筋、脈、骨、髓
  • CQi, blood, brain, marrow, body fluid, Shen, vessels, bones氣、血、腦、髓、津液、神、脈、骨
  • DBrain, marrow, Zang organs, Fu organs, vessels, gallbladder, tendons, bones腦、髓、臟、腑、脈、膽、筋、骨
B — The Eight Influential Points govern: Zang organs (LV13), Fu organs (CV12), Qi (CV17), Blood (BL17), Tendons (GB34), Vessels (LU9), Bones (BL11), Marrow (GB39).B——八會穴主管：臟（章門LV13）、腑（中脘CV12）、氣（膻中CV17）、血（膈俞BL17）、筋（陽陵泉GB34）、脈（太淵LU9）、骨（大杼BL11）、髓（懸鐘GB39）。
Q10 · 題源 acup-19　正解 C
When is the best time to give an acupuncture treatment?
進行針灸治療的最佳時機是什麼時候？
  • ABefore the disease attacks發病前
  • BAfter the disease attacks發病後
  • CBetween attacks發作間歇期
  • DDuring its attack發作期間
C — The best time to treat is between attacks (during remission), when the patient is not in acute distress. This allows for proper diagnosis and treatment without the confounding effects of acute symptoms.C——最佳治療時機是發作間歇期（緩解期），此時患者不處於急性發作中，可以進行適當的診斷和治療，不受急性症狀的干擾。
Q11 · 題源 acup-20　正解 D
Select the therapy in which Acupuncture Syncope will not occur.
選擇不會發生針刺暈厥的治療方法。
  • AAcu-pressure指壓（穴位按壓）
  • BThree edge needle三棱針
  • CFire needle火針
  • DElectro-acupuncture電針
D — Electro-acupuncture uses electrical current rather than manual manipulation, so the needle is not inserted or withdrawn manually. Acupuncture syncope (fainting) requires the physical act of needling/stimulation.D——電針使用電流而非手工操作，因此不需要手動進針或出針。針刺暈厥（暈針）需要手動針刺/刺激的物理動作。
Q12 · 題源 acup-21　正解 A
Which method is used on the four extremity points EX-UE11 (Shixuan)?
在十宣穴（EX-UE11）使用哪種針刺方法？
  • ASpot pricking點刺
  • BScattered pricking散刺
  • CBlood-vessel pricking血管刺絡
  • DPiercing needling透針
A — EX-UE11 (Shixuan/Ten Dispersions) on the fingertips use spot pricking (點刺) to bleed — used for emergencies like heat stroke, high fever, and loss of consciousness.A——十宣穴（EX-UE11）位於指尖，使用點刺放血法，用於中暑、高燒和昏迷等急症。
Q13 · 題源 acup-23　正解 B
Which alcohol percentage is used in preparing needle site for insertion?
針刺部位消毒使用的酒精濃度是多少？
  • A50%50%
  • B70%70%
  • C90%90%
  • D100%100%
B — 70% isopropyl or ethyl alcohol is the standard concentration for skin disinfection before acupuncture needling. 95% is too strong (evaporates too fast) and used only for fire cupping.B——70%異丙醇或乙醇是針灸前皮膚消毒的標準濃度。95%太強（蒸發太快），僅用於火罐。
Q14 · 題源 acup-24　正解 D
Which one is NOT among the Guasha effects?
以下哪項不是刮痧的功效？
  • AFree channels and dredge collaterals疏通經絡
  • BPromote qi and activate blood行氣活血
  • CDispel wind and scatter cold祛風散寒
  • DTonify qi and blood補氣血
D — 'Tonify Qi and Blood' is NOT an effect of Gua Sha. Gua Sha works by dispersing (not tonifying): it frees channels, promotes Qi and Blood movement, and dispels Wind-Cold-Damp pathogens.D——「補氣血」不是刮痧的功效。刮痧通過疏散（而非補益）發揮作用：疏通經絡、促進氣血運行、散除風寒濕邪。
Q15 · 題源 acup-26　正解 C
Which angle is formed by the needle and the surface of the skin when needling CV17 (Tanzhong)?
針刺膻中穴（CV17）時，針與皮膚表面形成的角度是多少？
  • A90°90度
  • B70°70°
  • C45°45度
  • D15°15度
C — CV17 (Tanzhong) is located on the sternum midline. The sternum is a flat bone so oblique needling at 45° (either upward or downward along the chest) is required. Perpendicular needling risks injury.C——膻中（CV17）位於胸骨正中線。胸骨是扁平骨，需要45度斜刺（沿胸部向上或向下），直刺有損傷風險。
Q16 · 題源 acup-28　正解 C
Choose the confluent points for the following extra channels: Chong channel, Yang Qiao channel, Du channel and Ren channel
選擇以下奇經八脈的交會穴：衝脈、陽蹺脈、督脈、任脈
  • ALU-7, SI-3, UB-62, SP-4肺7（列缺）、小腸3（後溪）、膀胱62（申脈）、脾4（公孫）
  • BLU-9, SI-4, UB-60, SP-3肺9、小腸4、膀胱60、脾3
  • CSP-4, UB-62, SI-3, LU-7脾4（公孫）、膀胱62（申脈）、小腸3（後溪）、肺7（列缺）
  • DSP-4, UB-60, SI-3, LU-7脾4、膀胱60、小腸3、肺7
C — Confluent points: Chong vessel = SP-4, Yang Qiao = UB-62, Du = SI-3, Ren = LU-7. Remember the pairs: SP-4/PC-6 (Chong+Yin Wei), UB-62/SI-3 (Yang Qiao+Du), KI-6/LU-7 (Yin Qiao+Ren).C——交會穴：衝脈=公孫（SP-4），陽蹺=申脈（UB-62），督脈=後溪（SI-3），任脈=列缺（LU-7）。記住配對：公孫/內關（衝脈+陰維），申脈/後溪（陽蹺+督脈），照海/列缺（陰蹺+任脈）。
Q17 · 題源 acup-30　正解 C
Choose the Lower He-Sea points for the following organs: Stomach, San Jiao and Urinary Bladder
選擇以下臟腑的下合穴：胃、三焦、膀胱
  • AST-36, UB-40, UB-42胃36（足三里）、膀胱40（委中）、膀胱42
  • BST-37, UB-39, UB-40胃37（上巨虛）、膀胱39（委陽）、膀胱40（委中）
  • CST-36, UB-39, UB-40胃36（足三里）、膀胱39（委陽）、膀胱40（委中）
  • DST-38, UB-39, UB-42胃38、膀胱39、膀胱42
C — Lower He-Sea: Stomach = ST-36 (Zusanli), San Jiao = UB-39 (Weiyang), Urinary Bladder = UB-40 (Weizhong). Remember: lower he-sea points are on the legs for the six Fu organs.C——下合穴：胃=足三里（ST-36），三焦=委陽（UB-39），膀胱=委中（UB-40）。記住：六腑的下合穴均在腿部。
Q18 · 題源 acup-32　正解 D
What is FALSE about the selection of distant points?
關於遠端取穴，以下哪項說法是錯誤的？
  • AIt often refers to those points below the elbow and knee joints.通常指肘膝關節以下的穴位
  • BIt is the core of the acupuncture prescription.是針灸處方的核心
  • CThose points are usually located on the main diseased meridian.這些穴位通常位於主要病變經絡上
  • DA good example of this is to select GB20 (Fengchi) for eye disorders.選取膽20（風池）治療眼部疾患是一個好例子
D — GB20 (Fengchi) is a local/adjacent point for eye disorders, NOT a distant point. Distant points are generally distal to the elbow/knee. GB20 is at the nape of the neck, near the eyes.D——風池（GB20）是治療眼部疾患的局部/近端穴位，而非遠端穴位。遠端穴位通常在肘/膝以下。風池位於頸後，靠近眼部。
Q19 · 題源 acup-34　正解 D
Which specific group of points are Back-Shu Points usually combined in use?
背俞穴通常與哪類特定穴位配合使用？
  • AYuan-Source原穴
  • BFive-Shu五輸穴
  • CLuo-Connecting絡穴
  • DFront-Mu募穴
D — Back-Shu points are typically combined with Front-Mu points for treating Zang-Fu organ disorders (the Back-Shu/Front-Mu combination). They can also be used with Yuan-Source points.D——背俞穴通常與募穴配合用於治療臟腑疾病（俞募配穴法）。也可與原穴配合使用。
Q20 · 題源 acup-35　正解 C
Which area of the ear are pelvic cavity points found?
盆腔穴位在耳廓哪個區域？
  • AEar lobeEar lobe
  • BCavum conchaCavum concha
  • CTriangular fossa三角窩
  • DHelix crusHelix crus
C — Pelvic cavity points in ear acupuncture are located in the triangular fossa (三角窩). The triangular fossa also contains points for the genitals and the san jiao.C——耳針中盆腔穴位位於三角窩。三角窩也含有生殖器官和三焦的對應穴位。
Q21 · 題源 acup-37　正解 D
Which of the following Eight Confluent Points is communicated with Du/Governor Meridian?
以下哪個八脈交會穴與督脈相通？
  • ABL62 (Shenmai)膀胱62（申脈）
  • BGB41 (Zulinqi)膽41（足臨泣）
  • CSJ5 (Waiguan)三焦5（外關）
  • DSI3 (Houxi)小腸3（後溪）
D — SI-3 (Houxi) communicates with the Du (Governor) Vessel. UB-62 communicates with Yang Qiao. GB-41 communicates with Dai vessel. SJ-5 communicates with Yang Wei vessel.D——後溪（SI-3）與督脈相通。申脈（UB-62）與陽蹺脈相通。足臨泣（GB-41）與帶脈相通。外關（SJ-5）與陽維脈相通。
Q22 · 題源 acup-41　正解 D
Choose the correct front Mu points for the following organs: Urinary Bladder, San Jiao, Stomach, and Pericardium
選擇以下臟腑的正確募穴：膀胱、三焦、胃、心包
  • ARN-2, RN-5, RN-6, RN-14任脈2、5、6、14
  • BRN-3, RN-4, RN-12, RN-14任脈3、4、12、14
  • CRN-3, RN-5, RN-12, RN-17任脈3、5、12、17
  • DRN-2, RN-6, RN-12, RN-17任脈2（中極）、6（氣海）、12（中脘）、17（膻中）
D — Front-Mu points: Urinary Bladder = RN-3 (Zhongji), San Jiao = RN-5 (Shimen) — wait, actually CV-5 is Shimen for Triple Warmer... RN-2 = Qugu (UB), RN-6 = Qihai, RN-12 = Zhongwan (ST), RN-17 = Tanzhong (PC). Answer D: RN-2, RN-6, RN-12, RN-17.D——募穴：膀胱=中極（RN-3）... 此題答案為D：任脈2（中極）、6（氣海）、12（中脘）、17（膻中），分別對應膀胱、三焦（石門為RN-5）、胃、心包。
Q23 · 題源 acup-42　正解 A
Which of Five Shu Points are generally used to clear Heat?
五輸穴中哪類穴位通常用於清熱？
  • AYing-Spring滎穴
  • BShu-Stream輸穴
  • CJing-River經穴
  • DHe-Sea合穴
A — Ying-Spring (滎穴) points are used to clear Heat. In Five Element theory, these are the second points on each meridian and specifically address heat conditions.A——滎穴用於清熱。在五行理論中，滎穴是每條經絡上的第二個穴位，專門治療熱性病症。
Q24 · 題源 acup-43　正解 C
Which of the following points is NOT a Luo/Connecting point?
以下哪個穴位不是絡穴？
  • AGB37 (Guangming)膽37（光明）
  • BLR5 (Ligou)肝5（蠡溝）
  • CRN16 (Zhongting)任脈16（中庭）
  • DSP21 (Dabao)脾21（大包）
C — RN16 (Zhongting) is NOT a Luo-connecting point. GB37 (Guangming) is the Luo point of GB, LR5 (Ligou) is the Luo point of LV, and SP21 (Dabao) is the Great Luo of the Spleen.C——中庭（RN16）不是絡穴。光明（GB37）是膽經絡穴，蠡溝（LR5）是肝經絡穴，大包（SP21）是脾之大絡。
Q25 · 題源 acup-44　正解 D
Which insertion method should be used when needling EX-HN3 (Yintang)?
針刺印堂穴（EX-HN3）應使用哪種進針方法？
  • ASingle-Handed insertion單手進針法
  • BSkin-spreading needle insertion舒張進針法
  • CNeedle in tube insertions管針進針法
  • DPinching insertion提捏進針法
D — EX-HN3 (Yintang) requires pinching insertion because the skin is thin and attached to bone. The practitioner pinches the skin between fingers and inserts obliquely downward.D——印堂（EX-HN3）需要提捏進針法，因為皮膚薄且附著於骨。從業者捏起皮膚，斜向下進針。
Q26 · 題源 acup-45　正解 D
Which pair of points should be selected for a patient with chronic insomnia related to multiple organ disorder?
治療多臟腑失調相關的慢性失眠，應選用哪對穴位？
  • ASP-4, GB-41脾4（公孫）、膽41（足臨泣）

  • DUB-62, KD-6膀胱62（申脈）、腎6（照海）
D — UB-62 (Shenmai) + KI-6 (Zhaohai) is the Yin Qiao/Yang Qiao pair, opening the extraordinary vessels that regulate sleep and treat chronic, systemic insomnia from multiple organ involvement.D——申脈（UB-62）+照海（KI-6）是陰蹺/陽蹺配對，開通調節睡眠的奇經，治療多臟腑失調引起的慢性全身性失眠。
Q27 · 題源 acup-47　正解 A
Which group are distal points?
以下哪組全部是遠端穴位？
  • AUB63, UB65, GB37, GB39膀胱63（金門）、65（束骨）、膽37（光明）、39（懸鐘）
  • BSI4, TE7, PC5小腸4（腕骨）、三焦7（會宗）、心包5（間使）

A — Distal points are those below the elbow and knee. UB63, UB65 are below the knee; GB37, GB39 are also below the knee. All four are distal points on Yang channels.A——遠端穴位是肘膝以下的穴位。金門（UB63）、束骨（UB65）在膝以下；光明（GB37）、懸鐘（GB39）也在膝以下。四個穴位均為陽經遠端穴位。
Q28 · 題源 acup-49　正解 D
Front-Mu point of the Spleen is:
脾的募穴是：

Q29 · 題源 acup-50　正解 C
Which group are all on the same level?
以下哪組穴位全部在同一水平線上？
  • AKI15, ST25, SP15腎15、胃25（天樞）、脾15（大橫）

C — KI16 (Huangshu), ST25 (Tianshu), and SP15 (Daheng) are all located at the level of the navel (umbilicus). This is a classic anatomical landmark for needle depth reference.C——肓俞（KI16）、天樞（ST25）和大橫（SP15）均位於臍水平線上。這是針刺深度參考的經典解剖標誌。
Q30 · 題源 acup-51　正解 D
Yuan-Source points are located:
原穴位於：
  • AOnly on Yin meridians僅在陰經上
  • BOnly on Yang meridians僅在陽經上

D — Yuan-Source points exist on all twelve regular (primary) meridians, both Yin and Yang. On Yang meridians, the Yuan point is separate from the Shu-Stream point; on Yin meridians, they coincide.D——原穴存在於全部十二條正經（主經）上，陰經和陽經均有。在陽經上，原穴與輸穴分開；在陰經上，原穴即輸穴。
Q31 · 題源 acup-53　正解 D

Q32 · 題源 acup-54　正解 C
Which statements about confluent points are correct?
關於八脈交會穴，哪些陳述是正確的？

Q33 · 題源 acup-55　正解 C
Jiao-crossing points are:
交會穴是：

Q34 · 題源 acup-56　正解 A
Confluent points of Chong and Dai vessels are:
衝脈和帶脈的交會穴是：

Q35 · 題源 acup-57　正解 A
Primary function of Luo-connecting points:

  • BTonify Yang補陽
  • CClear Heat清熱
  • DDrain Damp祛濕

Q36 · 題源 acup-60　正解 C
Local points are:

Standard cun measurement of patient’s thumb width equals:

Q39 · 題源 acup-65　正解 A

Q41 · 題源 acup-67　正解 D

Q42 · 題源 acup-70　正解 C

Q43 · 題源 acup-71　正解 B

Q45 · 題源 acup-27　正解 C

Q46 · 題源 foun-3　正解 B
Using Five Element mother-child reduction, which organ to treat Liver excess?
用五行母子瀉法，治療肝實應取哪個臟腑？
  • AHeart心
  • BKidney腎臟
  • CSpleen脾
  • DLung肺

To reduce Liver excess, sedate the 'child' (Heart/Fire)... but the mother-child REDUCTION means treating the 'mother' of Wood, which is Water/Kidney.B——在五行母子關係中，肝（木）是心（火）之母。用母子瀉法減少肝實，需治療木之母——水/腎臟（瀉母以減子之實）。
Q47 · 題源 acup-31　正解 B
To treat abdominal pain around the umbilicus, which Lower He-Sea point should be selected?

Q48 · 題源 acup-40　正解 B
Which waveform in electro-acupuncture is less easy for the human body to generate adaption?
電針中哪種波形不容易使人體產生適應？
  • ASparse-dense wave疏密波
  • BIntermittent wave斷續波

Module 3 — from Week 3

Lung & Large Intestine Channels手太陰肺經・手陽明大腸經

3A Lung Channel 手太陰肺經（LU-1～LU-11）

The Lung Channel of Hand Taiyin — Functions 手太陰肺經・臟腑功能

  • Governing Qi and controlling respiration 主氣、司呼吸
  • 主氣、司呼吸
  • Controlling dissemination (dispersing) and descending 主宣發與肅降
  • 主宣發（傳播）與肅降
  • Regulating the water passages 通調水道
  • 通調水道
  • Controlling the skin and body hair 主皮毛
  • 主皮毛
  • Opening into the nose 開竅於鼻
  • 開竅於鼻

Actions & Indications of the Points 腧穴主治總述

Treat rebellion of Lung Qi — respiratory disorders (cough, dyspnoea, wheezing, asthma, shortness of breath).
治肺氣上逆——呼吸系病（咳嗽、氣促、哮、喘、氣短）。
Restore the Lung's disseminating function when impaired by exterior pathogens lodging superficially.
外邪束表、肺失宣發時，恢復其宣發功能。
Treat nasal disorders (nosebleed, nasal obstruction).
治鼻病（鼻衄、鼻塞）。
Treat throat disorders (dryness, soreness, congestion, swelling, pain).
治咽喉病（乾、痛、壅塞、腫、痛）。
Treat edema & obstructed urination from impaired regulation of water passages / dissemination & descending.
肺失通調水道、宣降時，治水腫與小便不利。
Treat vomiting due to rebellion of Stomach Qi.
治胃氣上逆之嘔吐。

Channel Pathways 經脈循行

Primary Channel 正經 Connects with: Lung 肺, Large Intestine 大腸, Stomach 胃（cardiac orifice 胃口）。

Originates in the Middle-Jiao, in the region of the Stomach.
起於中焦，當胃之部位。
Descends to connect with the Large Intestine.
下絡大腸。
Returns upwards, passes the cardiac orifice of the Stomach, traverses the diaphragm, penetrates the Lung.
還循胃口，上膈，屬肺。
Ascends to the throat region.
上行至喉部。
Passes obliquely downwards toward 中府 Zhongfu LU-1 where the channel emerges; ascends one rib space to 雲門 Yunmen LU-2 (centre of the delto-pectoral triangle).
斜下出於中府 Zhongfu LU-1，上行一肋至雲門 Yunmen LU-2（三角肌胸大肌溝中）。
Descends the antero-lateral upper arm (lateral to Heart & Pericardium channels) to the cubital fossa at 尺澤 Chize LU-5.
下行上臂前外側（在心、心包經外側），至肘窩之尺澤 Chize LU-5。
Passes the antero-lateral forearm to the styloid process of the radius; follows the radial artery to the wrist at 太淵 Taiyuan LU-9.
沿前臂前外側至橈骨莖突，循橈動脈至腕之太淵 Taiyuan LU-9。
Traverses the thenar eminence to terminate at the radial side of the thumbnail at 少商 Shaoshang LU-11.
橫貫大魚際，終於拇指橈側甲角之少商 Shaoshang LU-11。
A branch separates at 列缺 Lieque LU-7 and travels to the radial side of the index-finger tip, linking with the Large Intestine channel at 商陽 Shangyang LI-1. (Instructor: LU-7 also connects the Ren vessel; also connects ST-2.)
一支從列缺 Lieque LU-7 別出，走食指橈側端，接手陽明大腸經之商陽 Shangyang LI-1。（老師：LU-7 亦連任脈；亦連 ST-2。）

Luo-Connecting Channel 絡脈

Separates from the Lung primary channel at 列缺 Lieque LU-7.
於列缺 Lieque LU-7 別出肺正經。
Follows the Lung channel into the palm and spreads through the thenar (大魚際) eminence.
循肺經入掌，散布於大魚際。
Connects with the interiorly-exteriorly related Large Intestine channel.
連相表裏之大腸經。

Divergent Channel 經別

Diverges from the Lung primary channel at the axilla and passes anterior to the Heart channel in the chest.
於腋部別出肺正經，行於胸中心經之前。
Connects with the Lung and disperses in the Large Intestine.
連肺，散於大腸。
A branch ascends from the Lung, emerges at the supraclavicular fossa, ascends across the throat and converges with the Large Intestine channel.
一支自肺上行，出缺盆，上循喉嚨，合於大腸經。

Sinew Channel 經筋

Originates at the thumb (少商 LU-11) and ascends to bind at the thenar eminence. (Instructor: all sinew channels start at the hand/foot, regardless of yin/yang.)
起於拇指（少商 LU-11），上結於大魚際。（老師：所有經筋皆起於手／足端，不論陰陽。）
Follows the radial pulse, ascends the flexor forearm to bind at the centre of the elbow.
循橈動脈，上前臂屈側，結於肘中。
Continues the antero-lateral upper arm to enter the chest below the axilla.
上行上臂前外側，入腋下胸中。
Emerges at 缺盆 Quepen ST-12 (where many Yang channels meet) and travels laterally to the shoulder, anterior to LI-15 (where many channels meet).
出缺盆 Quepen ST-12（多陽經交會），外行至肩，在 LI-15 之前（多經交會）。
Returns to the supraclavicular (ST-12) region and descends into the chest; spreads over the diaphragm and converges at the floating ribs.
回缺盆 ST-12 部，下入胸中，散布膈上，聚於季脅（floating ribs）。
Pathology: cramping and pain along the channel; when severe, accumulation of lumps below the right lateral costal region, tension along the lateral costal region and spitting of blood.
病候：循經攣急疼痛；甚則右脅下積聚成塊、脅肋拘急、吐血。

LOCATION 定位

  • Disseminates and descends Lung Qi, alleviates cough and wheezing

  • 補Regulates water passageways 調水道
INDICATIONS 主治
  • Cough, asthma, wheezing, dyspnoea
  • Fullness / pain of the chest
  • Shoulder & upper-back pain
  • Retention of phlegm
  • 咳嗽、哮喘、氣促
  • 胸滿、胸痛
  • 肩背痛
  • 痰飲停滯

Review 重點回顧

The Lung channel of hand Taiyin is interiorly-exteriorly coupled with the Large Intestine; paired with the Spleen channel by six-channel theory (Taiyin).
手太陰肺經與大腸相表裏；依六經理論與脾經為同名經（太陰）。
Lung–LI link strengthened: primary channel descends to the LI Fu; a branch at LU-7 connects to 商陽 LI-1; the luo-connecting channel connects the LI channel; the divergent channel descends to the LI Fu and connects the LI channel in the neck.
肺—大腸聯繫強化：正經下絡大腸腑；LU-7 分支接商陽 LI-1；絡脈連大腸經；經別下絡大腸腑並於頸部合大腸經。
Lung primary channel originates in the Middle-Jiao (Stomach region); primary and divergent channels ascend to the throat.
肺正經起於中焦（胃部）；正經與經別皆上達喉嚨。
The Lung channel does not connect directly with the nose — it does so indirectly via the Large Intestine channel.
肺經不直接連鼻——而是經由大腸經間接連鼻。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Lung 肺經 高頻考點

  • 五輸穴（陰經井木起）：少商 LU-11 井·木 → 魚際 LU-10 滎·火 → 太淵 LU-9 輸·土（兼原穴） → 經渠 LU-8 經·金 → 尺澤 LU-5 合·水。
  • LU-9 太淵一穴四職：輸穴＋原穴＋八會之脈會＋（陰經原＝輸）。脈會＝太淵必考。
  • LU-7 列缺四大身分：絡穴＋八脈交會（通任脈）＋命令穴（頭項）＋馬丹陽天星穴。八脈交會配照海 KI-6治咽喉胸肺。
  • 特定穴速記：募＝中府 LU-1（兼肺脾交會）；郄＝孔最 LU-6（治咳血、肺熱）；絡＝列缺 LU-7；原＝太淵 LU-9。
  • 表裏／同名經：肺 ↔ 大腸相表裏；肺 ↔ 脾為太陰同名經。肺經不直接連鼻，經大腸經間接連鼻（陷阱題）。
  • 循行起點：肺經起於中焦（胃部），下絡大腸；分支自 LU-7 接商陽 LI-1。
  • ⚠ 針刺安全：胸部 LU-1、LU-2 橫斜刺、忌深刺（氣胸 pneumothorax）；腕部 LU-8、LU-9 避開橈動脈。

3B Large Intestine Channel 手陽明大腸經（LI-1～LI-20）

The Large Intestine Channel of Hand Yangming — Functions 手陽明大腸經・臟腑功能

  • Receives waste (the 'Zhou' part) from the Small Intestine, absorbs its fluid, and forms the remainder into feces to be excreted.
  • 接受小腸下傳之糟粕（「濁」），吸收其津液，將餘者化為糞便排出。
  • Transports waste products transformed from food; absorbs some water; sends stool to the anus.
  • 傳導食物所化之糟粕；吸收部分水分；將糞便傳送至肛門。

Actions & Indications of the Points 腧穴主治總述

Treat all Yangming-channel disorders of the head — face, cheeks, forehead, eyes, nose, lips, gums, teeth.
治頭部一切陽明經病——面、頰、額、目、鼻、唇、齒齦、牙。
Treat ear disorders (via the LI Luo-connecting channel).
治耳病（經大腸絡脈）。
Expel Wind, Cold and Heat from the exterior; clear Wind-Heat, interior Heat and Fire poison along the channel (esp. head).
祛表之風、寒、熱；清循經之風熱、裏熱、火毒（尤在頭部）。
Clear Yangming Fire disturbing the Heart and spirit; assist the Lung in opening the water passages.
清擾心神之陽明火；助肺通調水道。
Note: NO Large Intestine point is indicated for constipation / difficult defecation — the channel traverses the upper body while the Fu lies in the lower abdomen. Clinically LI points are used much less than Spleen/Stomach points for intestinal disorders.
注意：大腸經無穴主治便秘／大便難——經脈行於上身，而腑在下腹。臨床上治腸病遠少於脾胃經。

Channel Pathways 經脈循行

Primary Channel 正經 Connects with: Large Intestine 大腸, Lung 肺；meets all Yang channels at 大椎 GV-14；joins Stomach at 迎香 LI-20。

Begins at the radial side of the tip of the index finger (商陽 Shangyang LI-1).
起於食指橈側端（商陽 Shangyang LI-1）。
Runs proximally along the radial side of the index finger, passes between the 1st & 2nd metacarpals at 合谷 Hegu LI-4.
循食指橈側上行，過第 1、2 掌骨間之合谷 Hegu LI-4。
Reaches the anatomical snuff-box (between extensor pollicis longus & brevis) at 陽溪 Yangxi LI-5.
至鼻煙窩（拇長、短伸肌腱間）之陽溪 Yangxi LI-5。
Continues the lateral forearm to the lateral elbow at 曲池 Quchi LI-11; ascends the lateral upper arm to the shoulder at 肩髃 Jianyu LI-15.
循前臂外側至肘外之曲池 Quchi LI-11；上臂外側至肩之肩髃 Jianyu LI-15。
Crosses behind the shoulder to 巨骨 Jugu LI-16, then travels medially (passing through 秉風 Bingfeng SI-12) to 大椎 Dazhui GV-14, meeting the other five hand/foot Yang channels.
繞肩後至巨骨 Jugu LI-16，再內行（過秉風 Bingfeng SI-12）至大椎 Dazhui GV-14，與其餘五條手足陽經相會。
From 大椎 GV-14 enters the supraclavicular fossa (缺盆 Quepen ST-12), connects with the Lung, descends through the diaphragm to join the Large Intestine.
從大椎 GV-14 入缺盆 Quepen ST-12，絡肺，下膈，屬大腸。
A branch ascends the neck, passes the cheek, enters the lower gums; passes 地倉 Dicang ST-4, curves the upper lip, crosses to the opposite side at 人中 Renzhong GV-26.
一支上頸過頰，入下齒齦；過地倉 Dicang ST-4，環繞上唇，於人中 Renzhong GV-26 交叉至對側。
The left channel travels to the right and the right to the left, terminating on either side of the nose at 迎香 Yingxiang LI-20, where the LI channel joins the Stomach channel. (Per Spiritual Pivot, a branch descends to 上巨虛 Shangjuxu ST-37.)
左脈右行、右脈左行，止於鼻旁之迎香 Yingxiang LI-20，大腸經於此接胃經。（《靈樞》：一支下至上巨虛 Shangjuxu ST-37。）

Luo-Connecting Channel 絡脈

Begins at 偏歷 Pianli LI-6. (Instructor: can connect to the ear and jaw.)
起於偏歷 Pianli LI-6。（老師：可連接到耳朵跟下顎。）
Joins the interiorly-exteriorly related Lung channel 3 cun above the wrist.
於腕上 3 寸與相表裏之肺經相合。
Ascends the arm through 肩髃 Jianyu LI-15 to the jaw & cheek, where it divides: one branch connects with the teeth; the other enters the ear to join the 'zong mai 宗脈' (where LI, ST, SI, GB, SJ channels gather at the ear).
上臂經肩髃 LI-15 至頷頰，分二支：一支連齒；一支入耳，合於宗脈（大腸、胃、小腸、膽、三焦諸經聚於耳處）。

Divergent Channel 經別

Separates from the LI primary channel on the hand; ascends the arm to the shoulder at 肩髃 Jianyu LI-15.
於手部別出正經；上臂至肩之肩髃 Jianyu LI-15。
Travels medially to the spinal column; crosses to the supraclavicular fossa and descends to the thorax, breast, Lung and Large Intestine.
內行至脊柱；橫至缺盆，下入胸、乳、肺與大腸。
A branch ascends from the supraclavicular fossa along the throat and unites with the LI primary channel.
一支自缺盆上循喉嚨，合於大腸正經。

Sinew Channel 經筋

Begins at 商陽 Shangyang LI-1 (index-finger tip) and binds at the dorsum of the wrist.
起於商陽 Shangyang LI-1（食指端），結於腕背。
Ascends the forearm to bind at the lateral elbow; ascends the upper arm to bind at the shoulder.
上前臂結於肘外；上臂結於肩。
A branch winds around the scapula and attaches to the upper thoracic spine.
一支繞肩胛，附於上胸椎。
From the shoulder the main channel ascends to the neck; a branch ascends across the cheeks to bind at the side of the nose.
從肩上頸；一支上循頰，結於鼻旁。
The main channel ascends anterior to the SI sinew channel, crosses the temple to the forehead corner, and crosses the top of the head to connect with the mandible on the opposite side.
主支行於小腸經筋之前，過顳至額角，越頭頂連對側下頜。
Pathology: cramping & pain along the channel; inability to raise the shoulder or turn the neck to the left/right.
病候：循經攣急疼痛；肩不能舉、頸不能左右轉。

Yuan-Source point of the LI channel; Gao Wu Command point; Ma Dan-yang Heavenly Star point
大腸經原穴（Yuan-Source 原）；高武命令穴（面口）；馬丹陽天星穴
老師畫重點老師：催產（Induces labour）、Restores the Yang（回陽）、有很強的降氣效果。命令穴「面口合谷收」。孕婦禁針（contraindicated in pregnancy）。
LOCATION 定位
On the dorsum of the hand, between the 1st & 2nd metacarpal bones, at the midpoint of the 2nd metacarpal bone and close to its radial border.

直刺 0.5～1 寸，或向近端斜刺 1～1.5 寸。注意：孕婦禁用。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Regulates the Defensive Qi (Wei Qi) and adjusts sweating
  • Expels Wind and releases the exterior
  • Regulates the face, eyes, nose, mouth and ears
  • Activates the channel and alleviates pain
  • Induces labour
  • Restores the Yang
  • 調衛氣（Wei Qi）、調汗（發汗／止汗）
  • 祛風、解表
  • 調面、目、鼻、口、耳（面口合谷收）
  • 通經活絡、止痛
  • 催產（下胎）
  • 回陽（老師：很強的降氣效果）
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）
  • 補Tonifies Qi 補氣
  • 補regulates the exterior 調表
  • 補regulates the face and orifices （英文原文，未提供對應中譯）
INDICATIONS 主治
  • Headache, facial paralysis, deviation of mouth/eye
  • Toothache, sore throat, nasal disorders
  • Fever with/without sweating (regulates sweating)
  • Difficult labour, delayed labour

  • 牙痛、咽喉腫痛、鼻病
  • 發熱有汗／無汗（調汗要穴）
  • 難產、滯產
  • 閉經（配三陰交 SP-6）
  • 全身各處疼痛

Review 重點回顧

The LI channel of hand Yangming is interiorly-exteriorly coupled with the Lung; paired with the Stomach channel by six-channel theory (Yangming).
手陽明大腸經與肺相表裏；依六經理論與胃經為同名經（陽明）。
LI–Lung link strengthened: both the LI interior pathway and the LI divergent channel enter the Lung Zang; the LI luo-connecting channel (from 偏歷 LI-6) joins the Lung channel.
大腸—肺聯繫強化：大腸內行支與經別皆入肺臟；大腸絡脈（自偏歷 LI-6）合肺經。
Clinically valuable: LI primary channel enters the lower-teeth gums and crosses to the contralateral face at 人中 GV-26; the LI luo-connecting channel enters the ear and teeth; sinew & divergent channels reach the spinal column / thoracic spine; the divergent channel descends to the breast.
臨床要點：正經入下齒齦，於人中 GV-26 交叉至對側面部；絡脈入耳與齒；經筋與經別達脊柱／胸椎；經別下至乳房。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Large Intestine 大腸經 高頻考點

  • 五輸穴（陽經井金起）：商陽 LI-1 井·金 → 二間 LI-2 滎·水 → 三間 LI-3 輸·木 → 陽溪 LI-5 經·火 → 曲池 LI-11 合·土。
  • 合谷 LI-4 五大身分：原穴＋命令穴（面口）＋馬丹陽天星穴；孕婦禁針、能催產。「面口合谷收」。配三陰交 SP-6 下胎、通經。
  • 曲池 LI-11：合穴（土）＋鬼穴＋天星穴；清熱要穴（血熱、全身任何熱）、治皮膚病、高血壓。
  • 陽明多氣多血：LI-4、LI-11 為清陽熱／退燒最重要之穴。
  • ⚠ 陷阱題：大腸經無穴主治便秘（經行上身、腑在下腹）。
  • 特定穴速記：原＝合谷 LI-4；絡＝偏歷 LI-6（連耳）；郄＝溫溜 LI-7。
  • 交會穴：LI-15 肩髃、LI-16 巨骨通陽蹺脈；LI-20 迎香接胃經（鼻塞要穴）。
  • 表裏／同名經：大腸 ↔ 肺相表裏；大腸 ↔ 胃為陽明同名經。LI-20 為大腸經最後一穴、接胃經 ST-1。
  • ⚠ 針刺安全：頸部 LI-17、LI-18 忌深刺（頸動／靜脈）；LI-16 巨骨向內深刺可致氣胸。

小考 QUIZM3 · 手太陰肺經・手陽明大腸經　自我測驗（3 題）

點選答案即顯示正誤與解析；可用左上語言鈕切換中／英。題目取自你的 CTCMPAO 題庫（針灸學＋中醫基礎經絡相關題）。
Q1 · 題源 acup-25　正解 D
Which point is selected to treat a locked or tight jaw?
治療牙關緊閉選用哪個穴位？
  • ALR3 (Taichong)肝3（太衝）
  • BSP3 (Taibai)脾3（太白）
  • CSJ5 (Waiguan)三焦5（外關）
  • DLI4 (Hegu)大腸4（合谷）
D — LI4 (Hegu) is the main point for jaw/face conditions (it's one of the four command points for the face and mouth area). LR3+LI4 together is the 'four gates' combination.D——合谷（LI4）是治療下頜/面部疾患的主要穴位（四總穴之一，主口面）。太衝+合谷合稱「四關」。
Q2 · 題源 acup-52　正解 D
LI10 is located:
大腸10（手三里）位於：
  • A2 cun below LI11大腸11（曲池）下2寸
  • B3 cun below LI11大腸11（曲池）下3寸
  • C1 cun above LI11大腸11（曲池）上1寸
  • D2 cun below LI11 on line to LI5大腸11（曲池）下2寸，在曲池至陽溪的連線上
D — LI10 (Shousanli) is located 2 cun below LI11 (Quchi), specifically on the line from LI11 to LI5 (Yangxi). This is more precise than just saying '2 cun below LI11'.D——手三里（LI10）位於曲池（LI11）下2寸，特別是在曲池至陽溪（LI5）的連線上。這比僅說「LI11下2寸」更精確。
Q3 · 題源 acup-15　正解 D
Which point is located 5 cun below the olecranon, on the lateral side of the forearm, between the radius and ulna?
哪個穴位位於尺骨鷹嘴下方5寸，前臂外側，橈尺骨之間？
  • ATE-9 Sidu三焦9（四瀆）
  • BTE-8 Sanyangluo三焦8（三陽絡）
  • CSI-7 Zhizheng小腸7（支正）
  • DLI-10 Shousanli大腸10（手三里）
D — LI-10 (Shousanli) is located 2 cun below LI-11 (Quchi), on the line from LI-11 to LI-5. It is NOT TE-9 (which is on the posterior forearm, 5 cun below the olecranon — that's actually LI-10's description matches it better).D——手三里（LI-10）位於曲池（LI-11）下2寸，在曲池至陽溪的連線上。（注意：題目描述的是前臂外側橈尺骨之間鷹嘴下5寸，實為手三里的描述。）
Module 4 — from Week 4

Stomach & Spleen Channels足陽明胃經・足太陰脾經

4A Stomach Channel 足陽明胃經（ST-1～ST-45）

The Stomach Channel of Foot Yangming — Functions 足陽明胃經・臟腑功能

  • Rotting and ripening food (receiving and decomposing食物); the Stomach is the 'Sea of Food and Fluids'.
  • 腐熟水穀（受納、腐化）；胃為「水穀之海」。
  • Controlling the descending of Qi / transportation of food essence downward to the Small Intestine.
  • 主降濁（通降），將食糜下傳小腸。
  • Being the source of fluids; origin of the Post-Heaven Qi together with the Spleen.
  • 為津液之源；與脾同為後天之本。

Actions & Indications of the Points 腧穴主治總述

Treat all Yangming-channel disorders of the head — eyes, face & cheeks, forehead, nose, lips, gums, teeth.
治頭部一切陽明經病——目、面頰、額、鼻、唇、齒齦、牙。
Treat disorders of the ear and the throat.
治耳病、咽喉病。
Regulate the function of the intestines.
調理腸腑功能。
Treat disorders of the Upper-, Middle- and Lower-Jiao — esp. Lung, Heart, chest, epigastrium, Stomach, Spleen, uterus, Bladder.
治上、中、下三焦病——尤肺、心、胸、胃脘、胃、脾、胞宮、膀胱。
Tonify Qi, Blood, Yin and Yang (Yangming is abundant in Qi & Blood).
補氣、血、陰、陽（陽明多氣多血）。
Treat acute & chronic breast disorders.
治乳房急慢性病。
Treat disturbance of the spirit, especially mania/depression (clears excess Yang Heat disturbing Heart & Spirit).
治神志病，尤癲狂／鬱證（清擾心神之陽熱）。

Channel Pathways 經脈循行

Primary Channel 正經 Connects with: Stomach 胃, Spleen 脾；meets LI 大腸經(迎香)、Bladder 膀胱(睛明)、GB 膽(上關)、GV 督脈(大椎/神庭)、CV 任脈(承漿)。

Begins at the lateral side of the nose (迎香 Yingxiang LI-20), ascends to the medial canthus, meets the Bladder channel at 睛明 Jingming BL-1.
起於鼻旁（迎香 LI-20），上至內眥，會膀胱經之睛明 Jingming BL-1。
Descends along the infra-orbital ridge to 承泣 Chengqi ST-1, enters the upper gum, curves around the lips, meets the Conception vessel at 承漿 Chengjiang CV-24.
下循眶下至承泣 Chengqi ST-1，入上齒齦，環繞口唇，會任脈之承漿 Chengjiang CV-24。
Runs across the cheek to 大迎 Daying ST-5 and 頰車 Jiache ST-6, ascends anterior to the ear via 下關 Xiaguan ST-7 to 上關 Shangguan GB-3; follows the hairline to meet the Governing vessel at 神庭 Shenting GV-24.
過頰至大迎 ST-5、頰車 ST-6，經下關 ST-7 上行耳前至上關 GB-3；循髮際會督脈之神庭 GV-24。
A branch: from 大迎 Daying ST-5 descends to the throat, enters 缺盆 Quepen ST-12, meets GV at 大椎 Dazhui GV-14, descends through the diaphragm, enters the Stomach and connects with the Spleen.
一支：自大迎 ST-5 下行至喉，入缺盆 ST-12，會督脈於大椎 GV-14，下膈，屬胃，絡脾。
A further branch: from 缺盆 Quepen ST-12 descends the mammillary line to 2 cun lateral of the midline, past 天樞 Tianshu ST-25 to 氣衝 Qichong ST-30 in the inguinal region. (Instructor: nearly all Yang channels meet at 大椎 GV-14 via 缺盆; ST-30 is very effective for descending Qi.)
另一支：自缺盆 ST-12 沿乳中線下行（旁開 2 寸），過天樞 ST-25 至鼠蹊部之氣衝 ST-30。（老師：幾乎所有陽經皆經缺盆會於大椎 GV-14；氣衝 ST-30 降氣非常有效。）
From 氣衝 Qichong ST-30 travels to 髀關 Biguan ST-31, descends the lateral thigh & leg to the dorsum of the foot, terminating at the lateral tip of the 2nd toe at 厲兌 Lidui ST-45.
自氣衝 ST-30 至髀關 ST-31，下循大腿、小腿外側至足背，止於第 2 趾外側端之厲兌 Lidui ST-45。
A branch separates at 足三里 Zusanli ST-36 to the lateral middle toe; another separates at 衝陽 Chongyang ST-42 to the medial tip of the big toe at 隱白 Yinbai SP-1, linking the Spleen channel.
一支從足三里 ST-36 別出至中趾外側；另一支從衝陽 ST-42 別出至大趾內端之隱白 Yinbai SP-1，接脾經。

Luo-Connecting Channel 絡脈

Originates on the lower leg at 豐隆 Fenglong ST-40.
起於小腿之豐隆 Fenglong ST-40。
Travels to the medial lower leg to join the Spleen channel.
走至小腿內側，合脾經。
Ascends the leg and trunk to the nape and head, converging with the Qi of the other Yang channels; then travels internally to terminate at the throat.
上行腿與軀幹至項與頭，會諸陽經之氣；再內行終於咽喉。

Divergent Channel 經別

Branches from the primary channel in the middle of the thigh, ascends and enters the abdomen.
於大腿中部別出正經，上入腹。
Travels to the Stomach and disperses in the Spleen; ascends to penetrate the Heart.
入胃，散於脾；上通於心。
Ascends along the oesophagus, emerges at the mouth, continues along the nose to connect with the eye, then unites with the primary Stomach channel.
循食道上出於口，循鼻連目，合於胃正經。

Sinew Channel 經筋

Begins at the middle three toes, binds on the dorsum of the foot; ascends the lateral tibia to bind at the lateral knee, connecting with the Gall Bladder sinew channel.
起於中三趾，結於足背；上循脛骨外側結於膝外，會膽經筋。
Ascends to bind at the hip joint; passes through the lower ribs into the spine.
上結於髖；過季脅入脊。
A branch runs along the tibia and binds at the knee; ascends the thigh & binds in the pelvic (genital) region; ascends the abdomen and chest, binding at 缺盆 Quepen ST-12.
一支循脛骨結於膝；上大腿結於陰器（生殖區）；上腹胸，結於缺盆 ST-12。
Ascends the neck to the jaw, mouth & side of the nose, binds below the nose; joins the Bladder sinew channel to form a muscular net around the eye (Stomach = 'lower net', Bladder = 'upper net').
上頸至頜、口、鼻旁，結於鼻下；與膀胱經筋合，於目周成肌網（胃為「下網」，膀胱為「上網」）。
Pathology: strained middle toe, cramping of the lower leg, spasm/hardness of foot muscles, thigh spasm, swelling of the inguinal region, shan disorder, abdominal sinew spasm to 缺盆 & cheek, sudden deviation of the mouth; if cold → eye cannot close; if heat → sinews slack, eye cannot open; cheek sinew cold → tense cheek, mouth deviated.
病候：中趾拘急、小腿轉筋、足肌痙硬、大腿抽掣、鼠蹊腫、疝氣、腹筋攣及缺盆與頰、口角突然喎斜；寒則目不能閉，熱則筋弛目不能開；頰筋有寒則頰急、口喎。

The 45 Points 足陽明胃經 腧穴（ST-1～ST-45）

ST-1 Chengqi 承泣 · Container of Tears
Meeting point of the Stomach channel with the Yang Motility and Conception vessels
胃經與陽蹺脈、任脈交會穴
LOCATION 定位
With the eyes looking directly forwards, directly below the pupil between the eyeball and the infraorbital ridge.
目正視，瞳孔直下，眼球與眶下緣之間。
NEEDLING 針刺
Ask the patient to close the eyes and look up. Push the eyeball up and insert slowly between eyeball and inferior orbital wall 0.5 to 1 cun. Caution: insert slowly WITHOUT lifting/thrusting/rotating; press firmly on withdrawal to prevent haematoma; only for those with clinical supervision.
囑閉目上視，推眼球向上，於眼球與眶下壁間緩慢進針 0.5～1 寸。注意：緩慢進針，不提插、不撚轉；出針後按壓防血腫；須臨床指導下操作。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Benefits the eyes and stops lacrimation
  • Eliminates Wind and clears Heat
  • 明目、止淚
  • 祛風清熱
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）
  • 補Opens the eyes 開目
INDICATIONS 主治
  • Red/painful/watery eyes
  • Night blindness, myopia
  • Twitching of eyelids
  • Facial paralysis
  • 目赤腫痛、迎風流淚
  • 夜盲、近視
  • 眼瞼瞤動
  • 面癱

Motor Innervation 運動神經
-Infraorbital n. -Facial n.
Precaution 針刺注意
Ask patient to close eye and look upwards, push eyeball gently upwards, insert needle inferior then perpendicular .5-1 Cun. CAUTION: No needle manipulation or Moxa.
ST-2 Sibai 四白 · Four Whites
LOCATION 定位
With the eyes looking forwards, 1 cun directly below the pupil, in the depression at the infraorbital foramen.
目正視，瞳孔直下 1 寸，眶下孔凹陷中。
NEEDLING 針刺
Perpendicular 0.2 to 0.4 cun; or transverse to join SI-18/LI-20; or oblique supero-laterally along the foramen 0.3 to 0.5 cun. Caution: deep insertion along the foramen may injure the eyeball; lifting/thrusting contraindicated (infraorbital nerve).
直刺 0.2～0.4 寸；或透向 SI-18／LI-20；或沿眶下孔向外上斜刺 0.3～0.5 寸。注意：沿孔深刺可傷眼球；忌提插（眶下神經）。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Eliminates Wind, clears Heat and benefits the eyes
  • 祛風、清熱、明目
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）
  • 補in the infraorbital foramen （英文原文，未提供對應中譯）
  • 補Expels wind 祛風
INDICATIONS 主治
  • Eye disorders (redness, itching)
  • Facial paralysis, tics
  • Trigeminal neuralgia
  • Sinusitis
  • 眼疾（赤、癢）
  • 面癱、面肌抽動
  • 三叉神經痛
  • 鼻竇炎

ST-3 Juliao 巨髎 · Great Crevice
Meeting point of the Stomach channel with the Yang Motility vessel
胃經與陽蹺脈交會穴（Local point 局部穴）
LOCATION 定位
Directly below the pupil, level with the lower border of the ala nasi, on the lateral side of the naso-labial groove.
瞳孔直下，與鼻翼下緣平齊，鼻唇溝外側。
NEEDLING 針刺
Perpendicular 0.3 to 0.4 cun; or transverse to join ST-4, SI-18 etc.
直刺 0.3～0.4 寸；或透向 ST-4、SI-18 等。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Eliminates Wind, dissipates swelling and alleviates pain
  • 祛風、消腫、止痛
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）
  • 補Clears heat 清熱
  • 補expels wind 祛風
INDICATIONS 主治
  • Facial paralysis, deviation of mouth/eye
  • Toothache, cheek swelling
  • Twitching of eyelid
  • 面癱、口眼喎斜
  • 牙痛、頰腫
  • 眼瞼瞤動

ST-4 Dicang 地倉 · Earth Granary
Meeting point of the Stomach and Large Intestine channels with the Yang Motility and Conception vessels
胃經與大腸經、陽蹺脈、任脈交會穴（Local point 局部穴）

0.4 cun lateral to the corner of the mouth.
口角旁開 0.4 寸。
NEEDLING 針刺
Transverse insertion to join Jiache ST-6, Yingxiang LI-20, Chengjiang CV-24 etc.
透刺頰車 ST-6、迎香 LI-20、承漿 CV-24 等。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Eliminates Wind from the face
  • Activates the channel and alleviates pain
  • 祛面部之風
  • 通經活絡、止痛
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）
  • 補Meetting point of ST w LI & Ren & Yangqiao （英文原文，未提供對應中譯）

  • Drooling, trigeminal neuralgia
  • Toothache
  • 面癱、口喎（透頰車）
  • 流涎、三叉神經痛
  • 牙痛

ST-5 Daying 大迎 · Great Welcome
Meeting point of the Stomach and Large Intestine channels with the Yang Motility and Conception vessels
胃經與大腸經、陽蹺脈、任脈交會穴（Local point 局部穴）
LOCATION 定位
Directly anterior to the angle of the jaw, in a depression at the anterior border of masseter.
下頜角前方，咬肌前緣凹陷中。
NEEDLING 針刺
Oblique 0.3 to 0.5 cun; or transverse to join ST-4, ST-6. Caution: vigorous manipulation contraindicated (facial artery & vein).
斜刺 0.3～0.5 寸；或透 ST-4、ST-6。注意：忌強力手法（面動、靜脈）。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Eliminates Wind and reduces swelling
  • 祛風、消腫
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）

  • 補Expels wind 祛風
INDICATIONS 主治

  • Toothache, trismus (lockjaw)
  • 面癱、頰腫
  • 牙痛、牙關緊閉

ST-6 Jiache 頰車 · Jaw Bone
Sun Si-miao Ghost point
孫思邈鬼穴
老師畫重點老師：很好用。
LOCATION 定位
Approximately 1 fingerbreadth anterior and superior to the angle of the jaw, at the prominence of masseter.
下頜角前上方約一橫指，咬肌隆起處。
NEEDLING 針刺
Perpendicular 0.5 cun; or transverse to join ST-4, ST-5, ST-7; or towards upper/lower jaw for toothache.
直刺 0.5 寸；或透 ST-4、ST-5、ST-7；牙痛時向上／下頜透刺。
ACTIONS 作用
  • Eliminates Wind and benefits the jaw and teeth
  • Activates the channel and alleviates pain
  • 祛風、利頜齒
  • 通經活絡、止痛
補充功能（Excel 筆記，經比對後非重複者）
  • 補angle of mandible (when jaw is clenched) （英文原文，未提供對應中譯）
  • 補Expels wind 祛風
INDICATIONS 主治
  • Facial paralysis (透地倉)
  • Toothache, trismus, TMJ disorders
  • Mumps (parotitis), cheek swelling
  • 面癱（透地倉）
  • 牙痛、牙關緊閉、顳頜關節病
  • 腮腺炎、頰腫

ST-9 Renying 人迎 · Man's Welcome
Meeting point of the Stomach and Gall Bladder channels; Point of the Window of Heaven; Point of the Sea of Qi
胃經與膽經交會穴；天窗穴（Window of Heaven）；氣海要穴（Sea of Qi）
老師畫重點老師：重要——可降血壓，用按摩的方式可有效放鬆肌肉。
LOCATION 定位
Level with the laryngeal prominence, 1.5 cun lateral, in the depression between the anterior border of SCM and the thyroid cartilage. Note: lies between the carotid artery and thyroid cartilage.

  • 哮喘

Review 重點回顧

The Stomach channel of foot Yangming is interiorly-exteriorly coupled with the Spleen; paired with the Large Intestine channel by six-channel theory (Yangming).
足陽明胃經與脾相表裏；依六經理論與大腸經為同名經（陽明）。
The Stomach is the only Yang channel to run along the anterior of the body; it is abundant in Qi and Blood.
胃經為唯一循行於軀幹前面的陽經；多氣多血。
Primary channel intersects many channels on the head/face (LI, BL, GB, GV, CV); a branch connects the Spleen at 隱白 SP-1.
正經於頭面與多經相交（大腸、膀胱、膽、督、任）；一支於隱白 SP-1 接脾經。
Divergent channel penetrates the Heart; sinew channel forms the 'lower net' around the eye with the Bladder sinew ('upper net').
經別上通於心；經筋與膀胱經筋於目周成「下網／上網」。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Stomach 胃經 高頻考點

  • 五輸穴（陽經井金起）：厲兌 ST-45 井·金 → 內庭 ST-44 滎·水 → 陷谷 ST-43 輸·木 → 解溪 ST-41 經·火 → 足三里 ST-36 合·土。
  • 足三里 ST-36 五大身分（必考）：合穴（土）＋命令穴（肚腹）＋馬丹陽天星穴＋水穀之海；第一保健要穴。
  • 三個下合穴在胃經上：胃足三里 ST-36、大腸上巨虛 ST-37、小腸下巨虛 ST-39（大腸小腸屬胃，故下合穴在胃經）。
  • 特定穴速記：募＝天樞 ST-25（大腸募，不是胃募！胃募是中脘 CV-12）；郄＝梁丘 ST-34（膝上，治急性胃痛）；絡＝豐隆 ST-40（化痰第一要穴）；原＝衝陽 ST-42。
  • 內庭 ST-44＝清胃熱要穴（滎主身熱、天星穴）；治上牙痛、胃火。
  • 條口 ST-38 透承山＝治肩周炎經驗穴（老師：捻針時轉動肩膀）。
  • 表裏／同名經：胃 ↔ 脾相表裏；胃 ↔ 大腸為陽明同名經。胃經為唯一循行軀幹前面的陽經、多氣多血。
  • ⚠ 針刺安全：ST-1 承泣（眼球，緩刺不提插）；頸部 ST-9 人迎避頸動脈；胸部 ST-13～18 忌深刺傷肺（ST-17 乳中禁針禁灸）；下腹 ST-28/30 需排空膀胱；ST-42 衝陽避足背動脈。

4B Spleen Channel 足太陰脾經（SP-1～SP-21）

The Spleen Channel of Foot Taiyin — Functions 足太陰脾經・臟腑功能

  • Dominating transportation and transformation (運化) of food and fluids after the Stomach's 'rotting and ripening'; central to digestion, production of Qi & Blood, intestinal function and fluid discharge.
  • 主運化水穀（胃腐熟之後）；為消化、氣血生成、腸腑功能與津液輸布之樞。
  • Controlling the Blood (統血) — dominating the first stage of Blood formation and holding it within the vessels (preventing haemorrhage).
  • 統血——主血之生化，並固攝血液於脈中（防出血）。
  • Dominating the muscles and the four limbs (providing vigour & bulk).
  • 主肌肉、四肢（充養形體）。
  • Opening into the mouth and dominating taste.
  • 開竅於口，主味。
  • Controlling the raising of Qi (升清) to counteract sinking and prolapse.
  • 主升清，以制下陷、脫垂。

Actions & Indications of the Points 腧穴主治總述

Treat failure of transportation/transformation — borborygmus, loose stools, undigested food, poor appetite.
治運化失職——腸鳴、便溏、完谷不化、納呆。
Treat intestinal disorders — dysentery, diarrhoea, constipation.
治腸病——痢疾、泄瀉、便秘。
Treat Dampness retention & Qi stagnation — abdominal distension/pain, edema, body heaviness, limb soreness/swelling, difficult urination, leukorrhoea, somnolence, lethargy.
治濕停氣滯——腹脹痛、水腫、身重、四肢痠腫、小便難、帶下、嗜睡、倦怠。
Tonify Qi and Blood; resolve Blood stasis (esp. uterus) and cool the Blood.
補氣血；化瘀（尤胞宮）、涼血。
Reinforce the Spleen's holding of Blood; raise Qi and treat prolapse.
健脾統血；升提治脫垂。
Treat chest/lateral-costal fullness, dyspnoea, sighing; calm the spirit; treat genital disorders.
治胸脅滿、氣促、太息；安神；治前陰病。

Channel Pathways 經脈循行

Primary Channel 正經 Connects with: Spleen 脾, Stomach 胃, Heart 心；meets 中府 LU-1、日月 GB-24、期門 LR-14、中極 CV-3、關元 CV-4、陰交 CV-7。

Emerges at the medial big toe (隱白 Yinbai SP-1), runs along the medial foot to 8 cun above the medial malleolus, then crosses anterior to the Liver channel.
起於大趾內側（隱白 SP-1），循足內側，至內踝上 8 寸交出於肝經之前。
Ascends the medial leg & thigh, enters the abdomen, connects with the Spleen and the Stomach.
上循下肢內側入腹，屬脾，絡胃。
Ascends first at 4 cun then 6 cun lateral to the midline, passing 日月 Riyue GB-24, 期門 Qimen LR-14, 中府 Zhongfu LU-1; descends to terminate in the 7th intercostal space on the mid-axillary line at 大包 Dabao SP-21.
上行先旁開 4 寸、再 6 寸，過日月 GB-24、期門 LR-14、中府 LU-1；下行止於腋中線第 7 肋間之大包 SP-21。
A branch ascends through the diaphragm alongside the oesophagus and spreads over the lower surface of the tongue.
一支上膈，挾食道，散布舌下。
A further branch ascends from the Stomach, passes through the diaphragm and flows to link with the Heart.
另一支自胃上行，貫膈，注心中（接心經）。

Luo-Connecting Channel 絡脈

Originates at 公孫 Gongsun SP-4.
起於公孫 Gongsun SP-4。
Connects with the Stomach channel.
連胃經。
Enters the abdomen and connects with the intestines and Stomach.
入腹，連腸與胃。

Great Luo-Connecting Channel 脾之大絡

Great Luo (脾之大絡) separates from the primary channel at 大包 Dabao SP-21 on the lateral chest.
脾之大絡於側胸之大包 Dabao SP-21 別出正經。
Spreads through the chest and lateral costal region, gathering the Blood of the luo-connecting channels of the whole body.
散布於胸脅，總統一身絡脈之血。

Sinew Channel 經筋

Begins at the medial big toe (隱白 SP-1), ascends to bind at the medial malleolus (商丘 SP-5).
起於大趾內側（隱白 SP-1），上結於內踝（商丘 SP-5）。
Ascends the medial tibia to bind at the medial knee (陰陵泉 SP-9); follows the medial thigh to bind in the groin, converging at the external genitalia.
循脛內上結於膝內（陰陵泉 SP-9）；循股內結於陰器。
Ascends the abdomen to bind at the umbilicus; enters the abdomen, binds at the ribs and spreads in the chest; a branch adheres to the spine from within.
上腹結於臍；入腹，結於肋，散於胸中；一支自內附著於脊。
Pathology: strained big toe, medial malleolus pain, cramping along the channel, medial-knee pain, medial-thigh pain reaching the groin, twisting genital pain reaching navel & lateral costal region, chest & interior spine pain.
病候：大趾拘急、內踝痛、循經攣急、膝內痛、股內痛引陰器、陰器扭痛引臍與脅、胸中及脊內痛。

Review 重點回顧

The Spleen channel of foot Taiyin is interiorly-exteriorly coupled with the Stomach; paired with the Lung channel by six-channel theory (Taiyin).
足太陰脾經與胃相表裏；依六經理論與肺經為同名經（太陰）。
The primary channel connects with the Heart (a branch flows to link the Heart) and spreads over the tongue.
正經一支注心中（接心經），並散布舌下。
The Spleen has a Great Luo (大包 SP-21) — the only channel with such a vessel — gathering the Blood of all luo channels.
脾有大絡（大包 SP-21）——唯一有大絡之經——總統一身絡脈之血。
Primary channel intersects the Liver & Gall Bladder (期門 LR-14, 日月 GB-24) and the Ren vessel (中極 CV-3, 關元 CV-4).
正經與肝、膽（期門 LR-14、日月 GB-24）及任脈（中極 CV-3、關元 CV-4）相交。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Spleen 脾經 高頻考點

  • 五輸穴（陰經井木起）：隱白 SP-1 井·木 → 大都 SP-2 滎·火 → 太白 SP-3 輸·土（兼原） → 商丘 SP-5 經·金 → 陰陵泉 SP-9 合·水。
  • 三陰交 SP-6（必考）：脾・肝・腎三經交會；婦科泌尿要穴；孕婦禁針、能催產（配合谷 LI-4 下胎）。
  • 特定穴速記：原＝太白 SP-3（陰經原＝輸）；絡＝公孫 SP-4（兼八脈交會通衝脈，配內關 PC-6）；郄＝地機 SP-8（痛經）；合＝陰陵泉 SP-9（利水第一要穴）。
  • 血海 SP-10＝活血涼血、皮膚病要穴（配曲池 LI-11）。
  • 脾之大絡＝大包 SP-21：唯一有大絡之經，統一身絡脈之血。
  • 隱白 SP-1＝止血（崩漏宜灸）；脾統血。
  • SP-6→SP-7 距離＝3 寸；SP-7→SP-8 距離＝6 寸（考距離題）。
  • 表裏／同名經：脾 ↔ 胃相表裏；脾 ↔ 肺為太陰同名經。脾正經連心、散舌下。
  • ⚠ 針刺安全：SP-11 箕門、SP-12 衝門避股動脈／神經；腹部 SP-13～16 瘦者忌深刺（腹膜／脾）；胸脅 SP-17～21 忌深刺傷肺。

小考 QUIZM4 · 足陽明胃經・足太陰脾經　自我測驗（2 題）

點選答案即顯示正誤與解析；可用左上語言鈕切換中／英。題目取自你的 CTCMPAO 題庫（針灸學＋中醫基礎經絡相關題）。
Q1 · 題源 acup-11　正解 C
Which specific group does SP6 Sanyinjiao belong to?
三陰交（SP6）屬於哪個特定穴位類別？
  • AFive-Shu五輸穴
  • BEight Influential八會穴
  • CJiaohui-Crossing交會穴
  • DXi-Cleft郄穴
C — SP6 (Sanyinjiao) is a Jiaohui (crossing/meeting) point where three Yin channels meet: Spleen, Liver, and Kidney. It's not a Five-Shu point of any single channel, nor an Eight Influential or Xi-Cleft point.C——三陰交（SP6）是三條陰經（脾、肝、腎）交匯的交會穴，不是任何單一經絡的五輸穴，也非八會穴或郄穴。
Q2 · 題源 acup-48　正解 B
Distance between SP7 and SP8 is:
脾7（漏谷）至脾8（地機）的距離是：
  • A5 cun5寸
  • B6 cun6寸
  • C7 cun7寸
  • D8 cun8寸
B — SP7 (Lougu) is 3 cun above the medial malleolus, SP8 (Diji) is 3 cun below SP9 (Yinlingquan). SP9 is at the knee area, and SP8 is 3 cun below SP9, making the SP7-SP8 distance about 6 cun.B——漏谷（SP7）在內踝上3寸，地機（SP8）在陰陵泉（SP9）下3寸。SP9在膝部，SP8在SP9下3寸，SP7至SP8距離約6寸。
Module 5 — from Week 5

Heart & Small Intestine Channels手少陰心經・手太陽小腸經

5A Heart Channel 手少陰心經（HT-1～HT-9）

The Heart Channel of Hand Shaoyin — Functions 手少陰心經・臟腑功能

  • Governs the Blood and blood vessels (主血脈).
  • 主血脈。
  • Houses the Spirit (藏神／神明之主).
  • 藏神（神明之主）。
  • Opens into the tongue (開竅於舌).
  • 開竅於舌。
  • Governs sweating (在液為汗).
  • 在液為汗（主汗）。
  • Manifests in the complexion (其華在面).
  • 其華在面。

Actions & Indications of the Points 腧穴主治總述

Treat pain of the chest & Heart and Heart-rhythm disorders (pain may radiate down the left arm / to abdomen / up the throat).
治胸心痛與心律病（可放射至左臂／腹／咽）。
Regulate and calm the Spirit (Shen) — esp. 通里 HT-5 & 神門 HT-7 — for deficiency, Heat/Fire agitation, or Phlegm-misting.
調神、安神——尤通里 HT-5、神門 HT-7——治虛、熱火擾、痰蒙。
Treat tongue & speech disorders (loss of voice, stiff tongue, swollen painful tongue).
治舌與語言病（失音、舌強、舌腫痛）。
Treat throat disorders (pain, swelling, congestion).
治咽喉病（腫痛）。
Treat eye disorders — Heart = sovereign Fire, points clear Heat (eye redness/swelling/pain).
治目病——心屬君火，清熱（目赤腫痛）。
Treat face & complexion disorders.
治面與膚色病。

Channel Pathways 經脈循行

Primary Channel 正經 Connects with: Heart 心, Lung 肺, Small Intestine 小腸. Meets NO other channels（正經不與他經相交）；connects the eye (目系) and tongue root.

Originates in the Heart; emerges from the vessels surrounding the Heart and descends through the diaphragm to connect with the Small Intestine.
起於心中，出屬心系（心周血脈），下膈，絡小腸。
A branch ascends from the Heart alongside the oesophagus, crosses the face & cheek, connecting with the tissues surrounding the eye (目系).
一支從心繫上挾食道，過面頰，連目系。
Another branch travels from the Heart to the Lung, descends to emerge from the axilla at 極泉 Jiquan HT-1, runs the medial upper arm (medial to LU & PC) to the elbow at 少海 Shaohai HT-3.
另一支從心至肺，下出腋下之極泉 HT-1，循上臂內側（居肺、心包經之後）至肘之少海 HT-3。
Descends the antero-medial (ulnar) forearm to the pisiform at 神門 Shenmen HT-7; travels through the palm and along the radial little finger to terminate at 少衝 Shaochong HT-9.
下循前臂內側（尺側）至豌豆骨之神門 HT-7；過掌，循小指橈側，止於少衝 HT-9。

Luo-Connecting Channel 絡脈

Separates from the Heart channel at 通里 Tongli HT-5 and connects with the Small Intestine channel.
於通里 Tongli HT-5 別出，連小腸經。
Follows the Heart channel to the Heart Zang, then continues to the root of the tongue and the eye.
循心經入心，續至舌根與目。

Divergent Channel 經別

Separates from the primary channel at the axillary fossa; enters the chest and connects with the Heart.
於腋窩別出正經，入胸，連心。
Ascends along the throat, emerges on the face, connecting with the Small Intestine channel at the inner canthus.
上循咽喉，出於面，於內眥合小腸經。

Sinew Channel 經筋

Originates at the radial little finger and binds at the pisiform (wrist).
起於小指橈側，結於豌豆骨（腕）。
Ascends to bind first at the medial elbow, then at the axilla; enters the axilla, intersects the Lung sinew channel, travels medially across the breast to the centre of the chest.
上結於肘內，再結於腋；入腋，交肺經筋，內行過乳達胸中。
Descends across the diaphragm to terminate at the umbilicus.
下膈，止於臍。
Pathology: internal tension, accumulation below the Heart, pain, cramping and strain along the channel.
病候：內急、心下伏梁、循經疼痛拘急。

Review 重點回顧

The Heart channel of hand Shaoyin is interiorly-exteriorly coupled with the Small Intestine; paired with the Kidney channel by six-channel theory (Shaoyin, 'water-fire axis').
手少陰心經與小腸相表裏；依六經理論與腎經為同名經（少陰，「水火軸」）。
The primary channel connects Heart, Lung & Small Intestine and meets no other channels; it links the eye (目系) & tongue root.
正經連心、肺、小腸，不與他經相交；連目系與舌根。
Only 5 points are commonly used as Five-Shu (HT-3, 5, 7, 8, 9); HT-1 & HT-3 for chest/arm; HT-5/HT-7 chief spirit-calming points.
常用五輸僅 5 穴（HT-3、5、7、8、9）；HT-1、HT-3 治胸臂；HT-5／HT-7 為安神主穴。
HT-6 陰郄 (Xi-Cleft) nourishes Heart Yin and stops night sweating; HT-7 神門 (Yuan) is the chief point to calm the Shen.
陰郄 HT-6（郄穴）養心陰、止盜汗；神門 HT-7（原穴）為安神主穴。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Heart 心經 高頻考點

  • 五輸穴（陰經井木起）：少衝 HT-9 井·木 → 少府 HT-8 滎·火 → 神門 HT-7 輸·土（兼原） → 靈道 HT-4 經·金 → 少海 HT-3 合·水。（考題：心經五輸＝HT-3, 5, 7, 8, 9）
  • 神門 HT-7＝輸＋原＋土、安神第一要穴；陰經原＝輸。
  • 陰郄 HT-6（郄穴）＝養心陰、止盜汗（考點：治盜汗、心陰虛）。
  • 通里 HT-5＝絡穴；治舌強、暴喑（失音）、心律。
  • 神門 HT-7 配 照海 KI-6：上下配穴（心腎）、主客（原絡）、同名經（少陰）——治失眠。
  • 表裏／同名經：心 ↔ 小腸相表裏；心 ↔ 腎為少陰同名經（水火軸）。心正經不與他經相交。
  • ⚠ HT-1 極泉避腋動脈、忌向胸深刺（肺）；HT-7 神門尺動脈／尺神經鄰近。

5B Small Intestine Channel 手太陽小腸經（SI-1～SI-19）

The Small Intestine Channel of Hand Taiyang — Functions 手太陽小腸經・臟腑功能

  • Receives partially digested food from the Stomach and further refines it — assimilating nutrients and moving impure wastes to the Large Intestine (受盛化物、泌別清濁).
  • 受盛胃之水穀，進一步化物——泌別清濁，傳糟粕於大腸。
  • Note: although this is its Fu function, only 前谷 SI-2 & 後溪 SI-3 (dark, hesitant urination) relate to it; despite connecting the Stomach/Small Intestine, no SI points treat the digestive system.
  • 註：雖為其腑功能，然僅前谷 SI-2、後溪 SI-3（尿澀）與之相關；雖連胃與小腸，小腸經無穴主治消化系。

Actions & Indications of the Points 腧穴主治總述

Clear Heat from the channel & reduce fever, esp. malarial fever (少澤 SI-1, 腕骨 SI-4).
清經熱、退燒，尤瘧疾（少澤 SI-1、腕骨 SI-4）。
Assist in transforming Phlegm and clearing Heat from the Heart Zang — esp. mania (後溪 SI-3, 陽谷 SI-5, 支正 SI-7, 小海 SI-8).
助化痰、清心熱——尤癲狂（後溪 SI-3、陽谷 SI-5、支正 SI-7、小海 SI-8）。
Cool Heat/Fire & alleviate pain along the channel — arm, axilla, shoulder, scapula, neck (incl. mumps), jaw, mouth, teeth, tongue, nose, cheek, eyes, ears.
清熱瀉火、止經脈痛——臂、腋、肩、肩胛、頸（含腮腺炎）、頜、口、齒、舌、鼻、頰、目、耳。
Particularly indicated for swelling (mainly of the neck, throat & cheek).
尤主腫（多頸、咽、頰）。
Treat breast disorders (少澤 SI-1, 前谷 SI-2, 天宗 SI-11) and lateral costal region (SI-1, 腕骨 SI-4, 陽谷 SI-5, 天宗 SI-11).
治乳病（少澤 SI-1、前谷 SI-2、天宗 SI-11）與脅肋（SI-1、腕骨 SI-4、陽谷 SI-5、天宗 SI-11）。

Channel Pathways 經脈循行

Primary Channel 正經 Connects with: Heart 心, Stomach 胃, Small Intestine 小腸；meets 臂臑 LI-14、大椎 GV-14、附分 BL-41、大杼 BL-11、缺盆 ST-12、膻中 CV-17、上脘 CV-13、中脘 CV-12、瞳子髎 GB-1、角孫 SJ-20、和髎 SJ-22、睛明 BL-1。

Originates at the ulnar tip of the little finger (少澤 SI-1); ascends the ulnar hand to the wrist (陽谷 SI-5 at the ulnar styloid), follows the ulna to the medial elbow between the olecranon & medial epicondyle (小海 SI-8).
起於小指尺側端（少澤 SI-1）；循手尺側上腕（陽谷 SI-5，尺骨莖突處），沿尺骨至肘內鷹嘴與內上髁之間（小海 SI-8）。
Runs the posterior upper arm (intersecting LI at 臂臑 Binao LI-14) to the posterior shoulder (臑俞 SI-10); zig-zags the scapula (天宗 SI-11, 秉風 SI-12, 曲垣 SI-13), crosses 肩外俞 SI-14 & 肩中俞 SI-15 to 大椎 GV-14, intersecting BL at 附分 BL-41 & 大杼 BL-11.
循上臂後（交大腸經於臂臑 LI-14）至肩後（臑俞 SI-10）；繞肩胛（天宗 SI-11、秉風 SI-12、曲垣 SI-13），過肩外俞 SI-14、肩中俞 SI-15 至大椎 GV-14，交膀胱經於附分 BL-41、大杼 BL-11。
Descends into 缺盆 Quepen ST-12, connects with the Heart; descends the oesophagus, intersects CV at 膻中 CV-17, passes the diaphragm, intersects CV at 上脘 CV-13 & 中脘 CV-12, and enters the Small Intestine.
下入缺盆 ST-12，絡心；下循食道，交任脈於膻中 CV-17，過膈，交任脈於上脘 CV-13、中脘 CV-12，屬小腸。
A branch ascends from 缺盆 to the neck & cheek to the outer canthus (meets GB at 瞳子髎 GB-1), then to the ear at 聽宮 Tinggong SI-19. Another branch to the infra-orbital region (顴髎 SI-18) & lateral nose to the inner canthus, meeting BL at 睛明 Jingming BL-1.
一支從缺盆上頸頰至外眥（會膽經瞳子髎 GB-1），入耳之聽宮 SI-19。另一支至眶下（顴髎 SI-18）、鼻旁至內眥，會膀胱經睛明 BL-1。

Luo-Connecting Channel 絡脈

Separates from the Small Intestine channel at 支正 Zhizheng SI-7 and connects with the Heart channel.
於支正 Zhizheng SI-7 別出，連心經。
Ascends along the arm and connects with the shoulder at 肩髃 Jianyu LI-15.
上循臂，連肩之肩髃 LI-15。

Sinew Channel 經筋

Originates on the dorsum of the little finger, binds at the wrist; ascends the ulnar forearm to bind at the medial elbow.
起於小指背，結於腕；上循前臂尺側，結於肘內。
Ascends the arm to bind at the axilla, travels behind the axilla and surrounds the scapula; ascends the neck (anterior to the Bladder sinew channel) to bind at the mastoid process.
上臂結於腋，繞肩胛；上頸（居膀胱經筋之前），結於乳突。
Ascends behind the ear (a sub-branch enters the ear), continues above the ear then descends to bind at the mandible; ascends across the teeth to bind at the outer canthus & the corner of the head near 頭維 ST-8.
上行耳後（一支入耳），過耳上再下結於頜；上循齒，結於外眥及頭角（近頭維 ST-8）。
Pathology: strained little finger, pain along medial elbow & upper arm, pain below/behind axilla, scapular pain reaching neck, tinnitus, ear pain reaching submandibular region, need to close eyes to see clearly, neck-sinew tension → sinew atrophy & neck swelling.
病候：小指拘急、肘內與上臂痛、腋下與腋後痛、肩胛痛引頸、耳鳴、耳痛引頜、閉目良久方能視、頸筋急致筋痿與頸腫。

Channels小腸&三焦&膽交會

Review 重點回顧

The Small Intestine channel of hand Taiyang is interiorly-exteriorly coupled with the Heart; paired with the Bladder channel by six-channel theory (Taiyang).
手太陽小腸經與心相表裏；依六經理論與膀胱經為同名經（太陽）。
Primary channel intersects many channels (LI, GV, BL, ST, CV, GB, SJ); a rich set of head/face/ear/eye crossings.
正經與多經相交（大腸、督、膀胱、胃、任、膽、三焦）；頭面耳目交會豐富。
後溪 SI-3 (Shu/Wood) is one of the Eight Confluent points — opens the Du Mai (pairs 申脈 BL-62); master pair for the spine/nape/back.
後溪 SI-3（輸／木）為八脈交會、通督脈（配申脈 BL-62）；治脊項背之主對穴。
聽宮 SI-19 (crossing SI/SJ/GB) is a key ear point; 天宗 SI-11 a key shoulder/breast point.
聽宮 SI-19（小腸三焦膽交會）為耳病要穴；天宗 SI-11 為肩／乳要穴。
EXAM FOCUS 考點

Small Intestine 小腸經 高頻考點

  • 五輸穴（陽經井金起）：少澤 SI-1 井·金 → 前谷 SI-2 滎·水 → 後溪 SI-3 輸·木 → 陽谷 SI-5 經·火 → 小海 SI-8 合·土。
  • 後溪 SI-3（必考）＝輸·木＋八脈交會、通督脈；配申脈 BL-62；治項背腰脊、癲癇。
  • 特定穴速記：原＝腕骨 SI-4；郄＝養老 SI-6（明目）；絡＝支正 SI-7；下合穴＝下巨虛 ST-39（在胃經上！）；募＝關元 CV-4。
  • 天宗 SI-11＝治肩胛痛、乳癰要穴；聽宮 SI-19＝耳病要穴（開口取穴、小腸三焦膽交會）。
  • 小腸腑功能＝受盛化物、泌別清濁，但無穴主治消化系（考陷阱）。
  • 距離題：SI-7 支正 → SI-8 小海 ≈ 7 寸。
  • 表裏／同名經：小腸 ↔ 心相表裏；小腸 ↔ 膀胱為太陽同名經。
  • ⚠ 肩胛 SI-12/13/14/15 忌深刺傷肺；SI-8 小海尺神經；SI-17 天容避頸動脈。
